CHINA PRESS

OCT 27 1939

Rent Case Is
Again Heard In
British Court

Judge Asks Landlord,
Tenant To Settle
Out Of Court

Judge Sir Allan Mossop, in the
British Supreme Court for China,
yesterday told the plaintiff and de-
fendant in a rent case that nothing
would please him more than to
have the case settled out of court.
He then adjourned the hearing
sine die.

The case was indirectly brought
by Mr. Peter K. C. Li, owner of
the Brookside Apartments, against
Mr. J. S. Chisholm, a tenant. Mr.
Li himself did not appear in court
but was represented by Mr. Elliott
Hazzard, who brought the suit as
agent and lessor, and by counsel,
Mr. H. A. Reeks.

Mr. Chisholm, who was present
in court but did not testify, was
represented by Mr. J. McNall.

In his complaint, Mr. Li charged
that the defendant had been served
notice on June 26 to vacate his
flat in the Brookside apartments by
August 1. He asked Mr. Chis-
holm to leave the premises and
pay rent for whatever period was
due at the rate of $185 per month
together with an additional $10 per
month for the use of a refrigerator.

Furthermore, it was brought out
in court, Mr. Li sought to collect
rent on the flat now occupied by
Mr. Chisholm at the rate of United
States $35 per month. This rental
increase Mr. Chisholm admittedly
refused to pay.

At this point in the testimony,
Judge Mossop advised counsel to
settle the case out of court and
adjourned the hearing.

In a previous hearing brought in
the Chinese court, counsel for Mr.
Chisholm told Judge Mossop yester-
day, that the court had ruled
against the complainant.

Another case involving rental
problems at Brookside Apartments
was heard in the Second Special
District Court yesterday morning.
The hearing was on a petition
brought by Mrs. Jean Taylor against
Mr. Li. The judge ruled that the
petition should be amended. Before
adjourning the hearing, however, he
advised the contestants to settle
their differences out of court if
possible.
pages.zh:
《大美晚报》

1939年10月27日

租金案再次
在英国法院
受审

法官要求房东与
租客庭外和解

英国在华最高法院的阿兰·莫索普爵士（Sir Allan Mossop）法官昨日在一起租金案件中告诉原告和被告，没有什么比双方庭外和解更令他高兴的了。随后，他无限期休庭。

该案间接由布鲁克赛德公寓（Brookside Apartments）的所有者彼得·K·C·李先生针对租户J.S.奇斯霍尔姆（J. S. Chisholm）先生提起。李先生本人未出庭，而是由作为代理人和出租人的埃利奥特·哈扎德（Elliott Hazzard）先生以及辩护律师H.A.里克斯（H. A. Reeks）先生代表出庭。

出庭但未作证的奇斯霍尔姆先生由J.麦克纳尔（J. McNall）先生代表。

李先生在诉状中指控，被告已于6月26日收到通知，要求其在8月1日前搬出布鲁克赛德公寓的单元房。他要求奇斯霍尔姆先生搬离该处所，并按每月185美元的费率支付任何欠付期间的租金，另加每月10美元作为使用冰箱的费用。

此外，法庭上还指出，李先生试图按每月35美元的费率收取奇斯霍尔姆先生目前所占用的单元房的租金。奇斯霍尔姆承认拒绝支付这一租金涨幅。

在此证言阶段，莫索普法官建议律师庭外和解此案，并宣布休庭。

奇斯霍尔姆先生的律师昨日告诉莫索普法官，在此前由中国法院审理的一次听证中，法院已裁定不利于原告。

昨日早晨，第二特区地方法院还审理了另一起涉及布鲁克赛德公寓租金问题的案件。该听证会是针对简·泰勒（Jean Taylor）夫人对李先生提起的申诉。法官裁定该申诉书应予修正。然而，在休庭前，他建议争议双方尽可能庭外解决分歧。

pages.en:
NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS,
OCT 27 1939
290

Rent Case Still
Unsettled

Chinese Court Rules That
New Requests Be Made
In U.S. Currency Case

No result was obtained yesterday
in the Second Special District Court
in connection with the hearing of the
new civil action filed by Mrs J.
Taylor, a tenant of Brookside Apart-
ment in Avenue Haig against her
landlord Mr. Peter K. C. Lee who
has been seeking her eviction and an
increase of rent by collecting the
same in American currency. The
judge took exception to the two re-
quests made in the plaintiff's petition
explaining that inasmuch as the re-
quests were identical with those
made in another petition previously
made by the plaintiff as the appellant
in the high court which had already
passed a judgment different requests
would have to be made in order to
renew the legal battle in his tribunal
which is a lower court.
The judge ruled that new requests
should be made in a written petition
in four or five days or else the plaint-
iff could withdraw the case. The
two requests disputed in court yes-
terday were: 1. that the court sees
to it that the rent lease shall continue
to be effective until its expiration on
October 1, 1940 and 2. that the land-
lord should not be allowed to collect
the rent in American currency. The
judge said that the Third Branch
Kiangsu High Court recently dis-
missed the same case in which the
same requests were made.

Sudden Notice

M. D'Auxion de Ruffe and Mr. L. F.
Tchou, lawyers for the plaintiff, pre-
sented their case stating that the
tenant whom they represented signed
a contract with her landlord before
occupying the apartment rooms she
rented. They said that it was clearly
mentioned that the contract should
hold good until October 1, 1940. Un-
expectedly, the court was told, on
June 26 of this year, the tenant sud-
denly received a notice from her
landlord asking her to pay her rent
in American currency (U.S.35) and
giving her one month's time in which
to vacate should she refuse to comply
with the request. It was contended
that the demand for the rent in for-
eign currency was an illegal one as
the original contract in which only
Chinese currency was mentioned still
held good.
To demand the rent in American
currency was contrary to the regula-
tions enforced by the Chinese govern-
ment. If the court allowed the
Chinese landlord to collect his rents
in American currency then foreign
landlords can collect their rents in
foreign currency from Chinese
tenants.
The lawyer for the defence told the
court that in his notice to Mrs. Taylor
served on June 26 asking her to va-
cate, his client, the landlord, gave her
one month's time in accordance with
Article 6 of the lease. The landlord
did not ask for American currency.
He merely asked her to leave by
serving a one-month notice which he
is permitted to do by the contract.
He admitted, however, that should the
tenant prefer to continue renting the
house she must pay her rent in
American currency. He mentioned
the decision reached by the Third
Branch, Kiangsu High Court in con-
nection with the same dispute assert-
ing that the two requests made in the
present case were identical with the
previous ones. The judge then post-
poned the hearing until different re-
quests are made by the plaintiff.
pages.zh:
《华北每日新闻》，
1939年10月27日
290

租金案仍
未解决

中国法院裁定在美元案中须提出新请求

昨日，在第二特区地方法院审理霞飞路（Avenue Haig）布鲁克赛德公寓租户J.泰勒夫人针对其房东彼得·K·C·李先生提起的新民事诉讼时，未获得任何结果。李先生一直试图驱逐她并通过以美元收取租金来增加租金。法官对原告申诉书中提出的两项请求提出异议，解释说，鉴于这些请求与原告此前作为上诉人在高等法院提出的另一份申诉书中的请求相同，而高等法院已作出判决，若要在其这一下级法庭重新开启法律斗争，必须提出不同的请求。

法官裁定，应在四五天之内以书面申诉书形式提出新请求，否则原告可撤诉。昨日在法庭上争议的两项请求是：1. 要求法院确保租赁契约持续有效直至1940年10月1日到期；2. 不允许房东以美元收取租金。法官表示，江苏高等法院第三分院最近驳回了提出相同请求的同一案件。

突然通知

原告律师D'Auxion de Ruffe先生和L.F.周（音译）先生陈述了他们的案情，指出他们所代表的租户在入住其租住的公寓房间之前，已与房东签订了合同。他们说，合同中明确提到合同有效期至1940年10月1日。法庭获悉，出乎意料的是，今年6月26日，租户突然收到房东的通知，要求其以美元（35美元）支付租金，并给予一个月的时间，若拒绝 comply with 该要求则需搬离。有人主张，以外币索取租金是非法的，因为仅提及国币的原始合同仍然有效。

以美元索取租金违反了中国政府执行的法规。如果法院允许中国房东以美元收取租金，那么外国房东也可以向中国租户以外币收取租金。

被告律师告诉法庭，在其6月26日送达泰勒夫人并要求其搬离的通知中，他的当事人（房东）根据租约第6条给予了她一个月的时间。房东并未要求美元。他只是通过送达一份为期一个月的通知要求其离开，而合同允许他这样做。然而，他承认，如果租户希望继续租用该房屋，她必须以美元支付租金。他提到了江苏高等法院第三分院就同一纠纷作出的决定，声称本案提出的两项请求与之前的请求相同。随后，法官推迟了听证会，直到原告提出不同的请求。

pages.en:
CHINA PRESS.

OCT 1 3 1939

Landlord Sued
For Imposing
Rent Increase

Unsuccessful Attempt
Said Made To Get
Payment In Gold

Chinese landlords of the Plum-
well Villas, Amherst Road, were
sued at the First Special District
Court yesterday by two foreign ten-
ants who complained that an 80
per cent increase on their rent was
far too unreasonable.

The case was considered to be of
great importance in local legal
circles in view of the fact that it
was the first case here where a
tenant directly contests the right
of a landlord to raise rent indis-
criminately.

The plaintiffs were Messrs. N. B.
Dlohda and Mr A. Koehler, who
occupy various houses in the Villa.
The defendants were Messrs. Wu
Brothers, owners of the Villa.

It was revealed by the plaintiffs
that at one time, the owners at-
tempted to obtain rent payments in
U. S. currency. When that at-
tempt failed, it was stated, their
rent was increased from $159 to
$275, representing an increase of
well over 80 per cent.

Arguing that they should not be
sued, the defendants told the judge
that they were not owners of the
Villa, which they said, was owned
by the Metropolitan Land Com-
pany, a British firm.

In support of their argument, the
plaintiffs told the Court that the
buildings in the Villa were in-
dividual houses and, unlike apart-
ments where the landlord generally
incurs large expenses for upkeep,
are cared for entirely by the
tenants.

The case was adjourned for an-
other hearing, which will probably
be held next week.

（批：似 8%）
pages.zh:
《大美晚报》

1939年10月13日

房东因强加
租金上涨被诉

据称尝试收取
金币未果

昨日，两名外籍租户在第一特区地方法院起诉了安赫斯特路（Amherst Road）普拉姆韦尔别墅（Plumwell Villas）的中国房东，投诉称其租金上涨80%极不合理。

鉴于这是本地首例租户直接质疑房东随意提高租金权利的案件，该案在当地法律界被认为具有重要意义。

原告为N.B. Dlohda先生和A. Koehler先生，他们居住在别墅内的不同房屋中。被告为吴氏兄弟先生，即该别墅的所有者。

原告透露，业主曾一度试图收取美元租金。据称，当该尝试失败后，他们的租金从159美元增加到275美元，增幅超过80%。

被告辩称他们不应被起诉，他们告诉法官，他们并非该别墅的所有者，并称该别墅归一家英国公司大都会土地公司（Metropolitan Land Company）所有。

为支持其论点，原告告诉法庭，别墅内的建筑是独立房屋，与房东通常需承担巨额维护费用的公寓不同，这些房屋完全由租户自行照料。

该案延期至另一次听证会，可能会在下周举行。

（批：似 8%）

pages.en:
NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.

OCT 12 1939

Shanghai Tenants Organized
To Fight Unfair Landlords

Large Attendance at Shanghai Tenants' Association
Meeting : Unanimous Support for Committee

THE fight against the rapacious landlord, members of which
well-stocked species abound aplenty in the city of Shanghai,
is now under way in earnest. Yesterday evening, in a crowded
Community Church Hall, about 250 of the city's tenants of both
sexes gave their full support to the recently formed Shanghai
Tenants' Association, by whom the meeting had been sponsored,
and unanimously backed a resolution authorizing the Association
to continue its splendid work in aiding the oppressed tenant.

The meeting was marked by loud bursts of applause during
short addresses given by three active workers on behalf of local
tenants, Mr. S. M. Edwards, Mr. J. S. Chisholm and Mr .Carroll
Alcott.

Presiding at the meeting was Mr.
E. S. Little, who was supported by
the three speakers and Mrs. E. G.
Merritt, hon. secretary. In his ad-
dress, Mr. Chisholm, acting chair-
man of the Association, stressed the
fact that the Association had not
been formed to "gyP" the landlord.
"We expect a fair deal from the
landlords," he said, "and they can
expect a fair deal from their
tenants."

He continued by outlining the
history of the Association which,
he stated, had come into being
soon after the landlord of Brook-
side Apartments had given his
tenants notice to pay rentals in
United States currency and after a
similar order had been given by
the landlord of Garden Apartments.
"Several of these apartments,"
Mr. Chisholm continued, "were
leased by the Shanghai Municipal
Council. I wrote to the Council
and asked if they were going to
meet the demand to pay United
States currency. I didn't get a
reply. I wrote again and I tele-
phoned and I got a reply (laughter)
—they had come to an arrange-
ment with the landlord not to pay
in foreign currency."

Here Mr. Chisholm paid a sterl-
ing tribute to the work of M.
D'Auxion de Ruffé, the Associa-
tion's legal adviser, who, he pointed
out amid applause, had expressed
his determination to help the Asso-
ciation and to waive all legal fees
at the present stage. "We owe a
deep debt of gratitude to Mr.
D'Auxion de Ruffé," the speaker
added.

Ambassador Approached

Mr. 'Chisholm then referred to
legal actions in which Mrs. Jean
Taylor, a British subject, and Mr.
Peter Li, a Chinese landlord, had
figured. Dealing with this he ex-
plained that a ruling had been
received from Chungking prohibit-
ing the payment of rentals in a
foreign currency. This ruling had
been appealed against and, until
a decision was received, they did
not know where they stood.

He expressed thanks to the Brit-
ish Residents' Association, which
had approached the S.M.C., F.M.C.,
and Sir Arcuibald Clark Kerr, the
British Ambassador. His Excellency
had given every consideration to
the tenants' case, said Mr. Chisholm,
but owing to the complex nature
of the situation in Shanghai he had
not been able to promise effective
action for a long period. The Am-
bassador and his staff, however,
were still working in that direc-
tion.

"Not all landlords are grasping,"
continued the speaker when paying
a tribute to landlords who had
kept their rentals within reasonable
bounds. He referred to the success
of the Association and prophesied
that the time was not far distant
when it would have to have an office
and secretary to deal with all the
business. In conclusion he appealed
for support and new members.

Genuine Distress in Shanghai

Mr. Edwards, who followed Mr.
Chisholm, said that there was a
very genuine distress in Shanghai
at the present time in many homes
because of mounting rentals. There
was no reason at present why
rents should not go higher unless
some action was taken to prevent
it.

He added that he had no griev-
ance against his own landlord but
he was there because he felt that,
in the interests of justice, all ten-
ants should work together. This
attendance on his part, however,
was not purely unselfish. He realiz-
ed that though at the present
moment a landlord might be treat-
ing his tenants fairly, there were
no grounds for belief that that fair
play would be continued.

Speculators, he said, were buying
up properties for no other purpose
than to exploit the tenants. Reason-
able treatment at the present mo-
ment was not a guarantee of
reasonable treatment in the future.
"It is essential for us to get to-
gether in numbers," Mr. Edwards
continued., "This is the only way
to bring about reduction in rents.
By concentrated effort and by
sheer numbers we can create a
great impression on the landlords
and, believe me, they are suscep-
tible to the pressure of public
opinion.

"If the tenants of Shanghai show-
ed that they were determined not
to be exploited, then the Consular
Body and the Council could be
approached and brought to rally to
their cause. There was no reason
why the Consular Body should not
help them, he said, and an order
could be made to stop landlords
charging a rental 50 per cent. above
the normal and to deny the right
to evict for not paying any in-
crease above 50 per cent. The
terms of the order could be left
to the wisdom of the Consular
Body," he added.
pages.zh:
《字林西报》。

1939年10月12日

上海租户组织起来
对抗不公房东

上海租户协会会议出席人数众多：一致支持委员会

针对贪婪房东的斗争——此类人在上海这座城市中比比皆是——现已认真展开。昨晚，在拥挤的社区教堂大厅（Community Church Hall），约250名男女租户全力支持由最近成立的上海租户协会主办的此次会议，并一致通过一项决议，授权该协会继续其在援助受压迫租户方面的出色工作。

在代表当地租户的三位积极工作者S. M. Edwards先生、J. S. Chisholm先生和Carroll Alcott先生发表简短讲话期间，会议上爆发出阵阵热烈的掌声。

会议由E. S. Little先生主持，三位演讲者和荣誉秘书E. G. Merritt夫人在旁协助。Chisholm先生在讲话中强调，协会的成立并非为了“欺骗”房东。他说：“我们期望从房东那里得到公平对待，他们也可以期望从租户那里得到公平对待。”作为协会代理主席，他接着概述了协会的历史，指出协会是在Brookside Apartments（音译）的房东通知租户以美元支付租金，以及Garden Apartments（音译）的房东发出类似命令后不久成立的。Chisholm先生继续说道：“这些公寓中有几处是由上海公共租界工部局租赁的。我写信给工部局，询问他们是否会满足以美元支付的要求。我没有收到回复。我又写了一封信，还打了电话，终于收到了回复（笑声）——他们已与房东达成协议，不以外币支付。”

在此，Chisholm先生对协会法律顾问M. D'Auxion de Ruffé先生的工作给予了高度赞扬，他指出，D'Auxion de Ruffé先生已表示决心帮助协会，并在当前阶段免除所有法律费用，此举赢得了掌声。“我们要深深感谢D'Auxion de Ruffé先生，”演讲者补充道。

接触大使

Chisholm先生随后提到了涉及英国侨民Jean Taylor女士和中国房东Peter Li先生的法律诉讼。对此他解释说，已收到来自重庆的一项裁决，禁止以外币支付租金。该裁决已被提起上诉，在收到决定之前，他们不清楚自己的法律地位。

他对英国居留民团表示感谢，该团已接触上海公共租界工部局、上海法租界公董局以及英国驻华大使Archibald Clark Kerr爵士。Chisholm先生说，大使阁下对租户的案件给予了充分考量，但由于上海局势复杂，他无法承诺在长时期内采取有效行动。然而，大使及其工作人员仍在朝此方向努力。

演讲者在向那些将租金保持在合理范围内的房东致敬时继续说道：“并非所有房东都贪得无厌。”他提到了协会的成功，并预言不久的将来，协会将需要设立办公室和秘书来处理所有事务。最后，他呼吁大家支持并吸纳新会员。

上海的真实困境

继Chisholm先生之后发言的Edwards先生说，由于租金不断上涨，目前上海许多家庭正遭受非常真实的痛苦。除非采取行动加以阻止，否则目前没有任何理由认为租金不会继续上涨。

他补充说，他对自己的房东并无不满，但他之所以出席，是因为他觉得出于正义的利益，所有租户应该团结合作。不过，他的出席并非纯粹无私。他意识到，虽然目前房东可能公平对待其租户，但没有理由相信这种公平待遇会持续下去。

他说，投机者购买房产的唯一目的就是为了剥削租户。目前的合理待遇并不能保证未来的合理待遇。Edwards先生继续说道：“我们必须大规模地团结起来。这是降低租金的唯一途径。通过集中努力和庞大的人数，我们可以给房东留下深刻印象，相信我，他们是容易受到舆论压力影响的。”

“如果上海的租户表现出他们决心不被剥削，那么就可以接触领事团和工部局，促使他们支持租户的事业。”他说，领事团没有理由不帮助他们，可以发布命令，禁止房东收取高于正常水平50%的租金，并剥夺因租户拒绝支付超过50%的涨幅而驱逐租户的权利。“命令的具体条款可留待领事团斟酌决定，”他补充道。

pages.en:
Council Not Sympathetic

"The Council are not I am
afraid, any too sympathetic to our
cause" Mr. Edwards continued. He
pointed out that the higher the rents
were, the higher the rates paid to
the Council were also. He was
afraid that they would not get the
Council on their side. To combat
this, however, they could call a
special meeting of ratepayers. He
concluded by asking for the loyal
support of all tenants.

Mr. Alcott introduced into his ad-
dress many of those pithy comments.
There was a definite need for such
an organization as the Tenants' As-
sociation, he said; in fact there had
been a desperate need for such a
body for many years. It took a
real crisis, however, such as the one
facing the salaried employees in
Shanghai today to bring it into be-
ing.

Because of conditions in Shanghai
the opportunities for profiteering
were unlimited. These conditions
gave landlords a chance to "milk" a
shell-shocked, disconcerted and
beaten public as never before. Some
landlords, he said, were not satisfied
with a reasonable return on their
investments but were tempted to go
on a gold or sterling basis while
their tenants were receiving salaries
in local currency.

"There is not one building in
Shanghai which was built in terms
of foreign exchange," he said amid
applause. Although a few of the
building materials had to be import-
ed, they were imported in terms of
local currency and the fact remained
that the commitments of most Shang-
hai landlords were in local currency.
Here he mentioned a case where a
landlord had increased a rent from
Shanghai $140 to U.S.$30, a 200 per
cent. increase at the present rate of
exchange.

The only way to curb the land-
lords was by organization, he said,
and the Tenants' Association would
be a powerful influence in fighting
the landlord and in preventing other
methods of profiteering, such as key
money and skyrocketing rents. He
remarked on the fact that this was
the first time in Shanghai that the
salaried workers had got together to
give the co-operatives a battle. He
finished by pointing out that while
rents were always the first to go up
and the last to come down, salaries
were always the last to go up, and
the first to come down.

Resolution to Empower Committee

The resolution passed was as
follows: "That this meeting approves
the action of the Committee of the
Shanghai Tenants' Association and
authorizes the continuance of its
efforts to obtain just and equitable
rentals. It empowers the Committee
to take whatever steps they may
consider necessary or advisable to
achieve this end."

The Committee was elected as
follows: Messrs. J.S. Chisholm, W.M.
Macoustra, British; L.D. Gholson,
American; S.M. Edwards, British;
Dr. Sundsbak, Norwegian; M.S.
Boutourlin, Russian; R. Schinazi,
American; Savul, Indian; A. Maude,
British; Dr. Leto, Italian; Major
Leitao, Portugese.

Just before the close of the meet-
ing a member of the Association
asked if action could be taken to
curb rising rents at the Y.M.C.A.
"They have increased these every
month since June," he added.

On the next page will be found
a report of the withdrawal of an
action by Mr. Peter Li, landlord of
Brookside Apartments, against Mrs.
Jean Taylor, British, tenant at the
apartments, in H.M. Supreme Court.
pages.zh:
工部局不同情

“恐怕工部局对我们的事业并不太同情，”Edwards先生继续说道。他指出，租金越高，向工部局缴纳的捐税也就越高。他担心他们无法争取到工部局的支持。然而，为了应对这种情况，他们可以召开纳税人特别会议。最后，他请求所有租户给予忠诚的支持。

Alcott先生在他的讲话中引用了许多精辟的评论。他说，像租户协会这样的组织确实有必要；事实上，多年来一直迫切需要一个这样的机构。然而，只有像今天上海领薪雇员所面临的真正危机，才能促使其成立。

由于上海的局势，牟取暴利的机会是无限的。这些条件使房东有机会以前所未有的方式“榨取”震惊、困惑和受挫的公众。他说，一些房东不满足于投资的合理回报，而是 tempted 试图以黄金或英镑为基础收取租金，而他们的租户领取的是本地货币薪水。

“上海没有一栋建筑是以外汇成本建造的，”他在掌声中说道。虽然少数建筑材料必须进口，但它们是以本地货币进口的，事实仍然是，大多数上海房东的支出是以本地货币计算的。在此，他提到一个案例，某房东将租金从上海银元140元提高到30美元，按当前汇率计算，增幅达200%。

他说，遏制房东的唯一办法是通过组织，租户协会将在对抗房东和防止其他牟利手段（如顶费和高昂租金）方面发挥强大影响力。他指出，这是上海领薪工人首次联合起来与合作公寓（co-operatives，此处指二房东或包租人）进行斗争。最后他指出，租金总是最先上涨、最后下跌，而薪水总是最后上涨、最先下跌。

授权委员会的决议

通过的决议如下：“本次会议批准上海租户协会委员会的行动，并授权其继续努力以获得公正合理的租金。授权委员会采取其认为必要或适宜的任何步骤以实现此目标。”

委员会选举结果如下：J.S. Chisholm先生、W.M. Macoustra先生（英籍）；L.D. Gholson先生（美籍）；S.M. Edwards先生（英籍）；Sundsbak博士（挪威籍）；M.S. Boutourlin先生（俄籍）；R. Schinazi先生（美籍）；Savul先生（印籍）；A. Maude先生（英籍）；Leto博士（意籍）；Leitao少校（葡籍）。

就在会议即将结束前，一名协会成员询问是否可以采取行动遏制青年会（Y.M.C.A.）不断上涨的租金。“自六月以来，他们每个月都在涨租，”他补充道。

下一页将刊登关于Brookside Apartments（音译）房东Peter Li先生撤回在英国最高法院对公寓租户、英国人Jean Taylor女士提起诉讼的报道。

SHANGHAI TIMES

31 12 1949

Landlord Withdraws Case
Against Mrs. Taylor

Chinese Landlord Will Not Continue His Case In
British Court Against His Tenant; Legal
Point In Defence Causes Withdrawal

The widely followed test case
between Mr. Peter K. C. Lee,
Chinese landlord, and Mrs. Jean
Taylor, a British tenant of the
Brookside Apartments 435, Avenue
Joffre, was terminated yesterday,
when the landlord and plaintiff
withdrew his claim for rent due
from the British Court.

This case, which started in the
Chinese District Court here when
Mrs. Taylor appealed against evic-
tion and continued in H. B. M.
Supreme Court where Mrs. Taylor
was the defendant and Mr. Lee
the plaintiff, became a test case
of the legal attitude towards evic-
tion and the payment of rent in
foreign currency, with Mrs. Taylor
strongly backed by the Shanghai
Tenants Association and Mr. Lee
standing in his capacity as a
landlord.

It will be remembered that when
the case first came up in H.B.M.
Court before Judge Sir Allan
Mossop last Thursday, the Crown
Advocate, Mr. John McNeill, who
appeared for the defendant, was
ordered to file defence before the
case could continue. This he did,
and Mr. H. A. Reeks and his
client, Mr. Lee, the landlord, after
studying the text of the case for
the defence, decided to withdraw
the claim and thereby put an end
to the case before it could go any
further. Mr. Lee will have to pay
the costs.

The reason why the claim was
withdrawn was outlined to a re-
presentative of "The Shanghai
Times" by Mr H. A. Reeks, yes-
terday afternoon. He stated that
upon examination of the case for
the defence, it had been revealed
that the landlord had received
money paid as rent after giving
notice to quit. In the eyes of the
law the landlord has waived the
notice to evacuate the apartment
by receiving this money, which he
received without stating that it
was "compensation for occupation,
and not rent." Therefore the
landlord has withdrawn his claim
and the Judge could give but
one decision.

At 4 o'clock yesterday afternoon,
Mr. H. A. Reeks gave formal
notice of the withdrawal of his
client's claim at the British Sup-
reme Court, thereby ending this
duel between a tenant and a
landlord. However, the duel in
principal between the tenants and
the landlords continues, for last
night a meeting of the Shanghai
Tenants' Association was held at
the Union Church Hall. This As-
sociation has been strongly sup-
porting tenants in legal actions
against their landlords.

（手写批注：）
Lee
C 12/10

《上海泰晤士报》

1949年12月31日

房东撤回对Taylor女士的起诉

中国房东不再继续在英国法院对其租户提起诉讼；辩护中的法律要点导致撤诉

备受关注的测试案件，即中国房东Peter K. C. Lee先生与霞飞路435号Brookside Apartments（音译）的英国租户Jean Taylor女士之间的纠纷，于昨日终止，当时房东兼原告从英国法院撤回了追讨欠租的请求。

此案始于本地中国地方法院，当时Taylor女士对驱逐令提出上诉，随后延续至英国在华最高法院，Taylor女士为被告，Lee先生为原告。该案成为检验法律对驱逐及外币支付租金态度的测试案件，Taylor女士得到了上海租户协会的强力支持，而Lee先生则以房东身份应诉。

记得上周四该案首次在H.B.M.法院由Allan Mossop法官审理时，代表被告出庭的皇家检察官John McNeill先生被要求在案件继续审理前提交答辩状。他照办了，H. A. Reeks先生及其客户、房东Lee先生在研究了辩方提交的案件文本后，决定撤回诉讼请求，从而在案件进一步审理之前终结了此案。Lee先生将承担诉讼费用。

H. A. Reeks先生昨天下午向《上海泰晤士报》记者概述了撤诉的原因。他表示，在审查辩方案件时发现，房东在发出迁出通知后仍收取了作为租金支付的款项。在法律眼中，房东收取这笔钱即视为放弃了驱逐公寓的通知，因为他收款时并未声明这是“占用补偿费而非租金”。因此，房东撤回了诉讼请求，法官只能做出一种判决。

昨天下午4点，H. A. Reeks先生在英国最高法院正式通知撤回其客户的诉讼请求，从而结束了这场租户与房东之间的对决。然而，租户与房东之间原则性的斗争仍在继续，因为昨晚上海租户协会在联合教堂大厅举行了一次会议。该协会一直在法律诉讼中强力支持租户对抗其房东。

（手写批注：）
Lee

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. E. REGISTRY
No. S. U. D. ____
Date ____

OCT 11 1939

Landlord Drops
Claim For Rent

P. Pi Withdraws Suit
Against Tenant
In HM Court

The Shanghai Tenants Association, which is holding its first general meeting today, this morning scored a notable success in the Mrs. Jean Taylor-Peter Li duel, when the case brought by the Chinese landlord was withdrawn in the British Court this morning. Peter Li will have to pay the costs.

Li was successfully sued by a British tenant when the landlord tried to charge rental in gold dollars, but a second and similar case brought by Mrs. Taylor was rejected on a technicality. Mrs. Taylor decided to appeal the decision, and Peter Li announced that he was appealing the decision against him in the first case. He also decided on a counter-claim against Mrs. Taylor, but apparently his lawyers have decided that he wouldn't have had a chance of winning it.

The Shanghai Tenants Association meeting is to take place at last today, at 5.30 p.m. in the Union Church Hall on Soochow Road. Admission will be by card. Speakers today are to be Messrs. Carroll Alcott, S. M. Edwards and J.S. Chisholm.

The meeting was originally scheduled for some weeks ago, but postponed at the request of the Shanghai Municipal Council owing to the political situation prevailing at that time. Subsequently the inaugural committee has been putting in a great deal of work, as a result of which three court cases have been brought.

An arbitration board was arranged by the General Chamber of Commerce at the request of the SMC, but so far no case has gone before it. Fees, thanks to a Shanghai Evening Post article which showed what arbitration would cost the small man, were reduced in a public spirited action by the Chamber of Commerce to a flat rate of $50.

（批：Thanks
Li

上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. E. 登记处
编号 S. U. D. ____
日期 ____

1939年10月11日

房东放弃
租金索赔

P. Li 撤回
在英王陛下法院
对租户的起诉

上海租户协会今日举行首次全体大会，今晨在泰勒夫人（Mrs. Jean Taylor）与彼得·李（Peter Li）的对决中取得了显著成功，这位中国房东于今晨在英国法院撤回了起诉。彼得·李须承担诉讼费用。

此前，当该房东试图以金美元收取租金时，一名英国租户成功对其提起诉讼；而泰勒夫人提起的第二起类似案件则因技术性问题被驳回。泰勒夫人决定对该裁决提出上诉，彼得·李也宣布就第一起案件中针对他的裁决提出上诉。他还决定对泰勒夫人提出反诉，但显然他的律师认为他胜诉无望。

上海租户协会会议定于今日下午5时30分在苏州路联合教堂大厅最终举行。凭卡入场。今日的演讲者为卡罗尔·奥尔科特（Carroll Alcott）、S. M. 爱德华兹（S. M. Edwards）和 J.S. 奇泽姆（J.S. Chisholm）先生。

会议原定于数周前举行，但因当时的政治局势，应上海公共租界工部局的要求而推迟。此后，筹备委员会开展了大量工作，由此引发了三起法庭案件。

应上海公共租界工部局的要求，上海总商会安排了一个仲裁委员会，但迄今尚无案件提交该委员会审理。得益于《上海晚邮报》一篇文章揭示了仲裁对小人物而言的成本，总商会出于公益精神将费用降至固定费率50美元。

（批注：谢谢
李
6. 4/10）

OCT 1939
NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.
Chinese Landlord
Sues Briton
Mrs. Jean Taylor Appears
As Defendant In Hearing
Of Claim for Possession

A Chinese landlord's claim for
recovery of possession of premises
at present occupied by a British
lady, Mrs. Jean Taylor, was adjourned
until Tuesday by Judge Sir Allan
Mossop in H.M. Supreme Court, yes-
terday after a short hearing. A
statement of defence was ordered to
be filed by tomorrow after counsel
for plaintiff had outlined the facts
of her case.
The plaintiff in the case was Mr.
Peter Li, landlord of Brookside
Apartments, 435 Avenue Haig, Mrs.
Taylor being his tenant in the
apartments. He was represented by
Mr. H. A. Reeks while Mr. John
McNeill appeared for the defendant.
Outlining his case, Mr. Reeks
stated that this was a claim for re-
covery of possession of premises.
A lease had been signed on Decem-
ber 13, 1938 between the plaintiff
and the defendant. There was a
clause in the lease, he added, by
which it could be cancelled by
either party by giving one calendar
month's notice.

Interpretation Questioned
On January 26 plaintiff gave the
defendant notice to return possession
of the premises but Mrs. Taylor was
still in possession and he asked that
an order that possession be returned,
and that mean profits in the form
of rent to be paid, be made.
Mr. McNeill stated that he did not
dispute the terms of the lease but
he did dispute the interpretation
placed upon these terms and he
enumerated various clauses with
which the defence disagreed. At
this point Mr. McNeill pointed out
that various documents connected
with the case were at present in
the custody of the Chinese Court
where an action between the two
parties was being fought.
Mr. Reeks then asked if the
defence would be based on law and
the Judge jocularly remarked "You
will probably want to go through
the Chinese Civil Code very care-
fully in order to teach me a bit
about Chinese law." The case was
then adjourned.

File

1939年10月
《字林西报》。
中国房东
起诉英国人
让·泰勒夫人
作为被告出席
占有权索赔听证会

一位中国房东要求收回目前由英国女士让·泰勒夫人占用的房产占有权的索赔，昨日在英王陛下最高法院经简短听证后，被艾伦·莫索普爵士（Sir Allan Mossop）法官延期至周二审理。在原告律师概述其案情事实后，法院命令被告于明日提交答辩状。

本案原告为海格路435号布鲁克赛德公寓（Brookside Apartments）的房东彼得·李（Peter Li）先生，泰勒夫人为其公寓租户。原告由 H. A. 里克斯（H. A. Reeks）先生代理，被告则由约翰·麦克尼尔（John McNeill）先生出庭。

里克斯先生在概述案情时表示，这是一项收回房产占有权的索赔。原告与被告于1938年12月13日签署了一份租赁契约。他补充说，契约中有一项条款，规定任何一方只需提前一个日历月通知即可取消契约。

对解释提出质疑
原告于1月26日向被告发出归还房产占有权的通知，但泰勒夫人仍占据该房产，因此他请求法院下令归还占有权，并支付以租金形式体现的预期利润。

麦克尼尔先生表示，他不否认租赁契约的条款，但他对这些条款的解释持有异议，并列举了辩方不同意的各项条款。此时，麦克尼尔先生指出，与本案相关的各种文件目前由中国法院保管，双方正在该院进行诉讼。

随后，里克斯先生询问辩方是否将依据法律进行辩护，法官诙谐地说道：“你可能想非常仔细地研读《中华民国民法典》，以便教我一点中国法律知识。”随后案件休庭。

归档
C 1/10

pages.en:
Action in Chinese Court

The appeal filed by Mrs. J.
Taylor, a British subject, with the
Third Branch Kiangsu High Court
against her landlord, Mr. Peter
K. C. Lee, in a legal battle in
which the former refused to pay
her rent in United States currency
was dismissed by the court yester-
day. The judge stated, however,
that if his decision did not satisfy
the appellant she could file an
appeal with the Supreme Court.
An appeal will be filed, it was
announced by M. d'Auxion de
Ruffe who appeared for Mrs.
Taylor.

This interesting case is sponsored
by the Shanghai Tenants Associa-
tion for Mrs. Taylor but the point
at issue raised by the lawyer for
the defendant, Mr. T. C. Chen,
was that in a rent contract signed
between the landlord and Mrs.
Taylor it was provided that before
the former wanted to request
evacuation he must serve one
month's notice and that such a
notice had been served. Counsel for
appellant contested at the previous
hearing that the lease signed would
be valid until October 1, 1940, and
that she could not be evicted until
that time.

He also opposed the demand that
his client should be asked to pay
her rent in United States currency,
asserting that it was contrary to
law. At the hearing held on Mon-
day he pointed out that a ruling
of the Ministry of Finance of the
Chinese Government, promulgated
in 1937, provided that all rents
should be paid in the Chinese na-
tional currency and calculated on
that basis during the period of
national emergency.
pages.zh:
在中国法院的诉讼

英国臣民 J. 泰勒夫人就其拒绝以美国货币支付租金的法律纠纷，向江苏高等法院第三分院对其房东彼得·K. C. 李（Peter K. C. Lee）先生提起的上诉，昨日被法院驳回。然而，法官表示，如果上诉人对该裁决不满意，她可以向最高法院提起上诉。代表泰勒夫人出庭的 M. d'Auxion de Ruffe 宣布，将提起上诉。

这起有趣的案件由上海租户协会为泰勒夫人提供支持，但被告律师 T. C. 陈（T. C. Chen）先生提出的争议点是，在房东与泰勒夫人签署的租金合同中规定，前者若要求搬离，必须提前一个月发出通知，且此类通知已发出。上诉人的律师在先前的听证会上争辩说，签署的租赁契约有效期至1940年10月1日，在此之前不得将其驱逐。

他还反对要求其客户以美国货币支付租金的要求，声称这违反法律。在周一举行的听证会上，他指出，中国政府财政部于1937年颁布的一项法令规定，在国家紧急状态期间，所有租金应以中国法定货币支付并以此为基础计算。

pages.en:
CHINA PRESS.
Local Tenant
Body To Meet
On Oct. 11

Many Landlords Again
Increase Rent By
About 40%

While the Shanghai Tenant As-
sociation prepares for its first
general meeting on October 11,
many Shanghai landlords yester-
day notified their tenants that
"with regret" their rents would
be increased by from 20 to 40 per
cent as of November 1.
In many cases the latest rental
increase represented a 100 per cent
increase as compared with the pre-
war rates.
Contending that the living cost
in Shanghai had mounted to an
unprecedented high, the landlords
demanding the rent increase stat-
ed in their notifications that they
have found no other way out.

Angered Tenant
Interviewed by a CHINA PRESS re-
porter, a disgruntled tenant in no
uncertain terms stated that the
demanded rise is not at all justified.
"My rent has been increased
three times during the past 18
months," he said. "Before the war,
I paid $120 for my apartment. This
was subsequently raised to $150
in June, 1938.
"Four months later, it went up
$25 again on the pretext that coal
for heating was much too expen-
sive but with the promise that the
increase would be cancelled when
spring returns.
"Spring came but nothing hap-
pened. We did not want to make
any trouble and kept paying the
$175 rate. Then out of the blue
this morning, the notice came
that my rent would be raised to
$240 per mensem, exactly 100 per
cent more than the pre-war rate.
We are going to fight the raise,"
he concluded emphatically.

Tenant To Fight
Just how our informant is going
to "fight" he did not disclose. But
it has been reported that the courts
will be kept busy for some time to
come with litigations between
tenants and landlords. Many of the
cases involved tenants whose land-
lords made demands on them that
they pay their rent in U.S. dollars.
The Shanghai Tenant Associa-
tion was organized in an effort to
check unreasonable increases in

《大美晚报》。
本地租户
团体将于
10月11日开会

许多房东再次
将租金提高
约40%

在上海租户协会准备于10月11日召开首次全体大会之际，许多上海房东昨日通知其租户，“遗憾地”告知他们自11月1日起租金将上涨20%至40%。

在许多情况下，最近的租金涨幅相比战前水平代表了100%的增长。

房东们在通知中声称，鉴于上海的生活成本已升至前所未有的高位，他们发现别无他法，因此要求增加租金。

愤怒的租户
一位不满的租户在接受《大美晚报》记者采访时，毫不含糊地表示，所要求的涨幅完全不合理。“在过去18个月里，我的租金涨了三次，”他说。“战前，我的公寓租金是120美元。随后在1938年6月涨至150美元。

“四个月后，又以取暖用煤过于昂贵为借口再次上涨25美元，但承诺春天来临时将取消这一涨幅。

“春天来了，但什么也没发生。我们不想惹麻烦，继续支付175美元的租金。然后今天早晨突然收到通知，我的每月租金将涨至240美元，恰好比战前水平高出100%。我们将对抗这次涨价，”他 emphatically 总结道。

租户将抗争
我们的消息源并未透露他将如何“抗争”。但有报道称，未来一段时间内，法院将忙于处理租户与房东之间的诉讼。许多案件涉及房东要求租户以美元支付租金的情况。

上海租户协会的成立旨在遏制不合理的租金上涨。其全体大会将于10月11日下午5时开始。

CHINA PRESS
SEP 28 1939

3 Employees
Get Suspended
Prison Terms

“Unreasonable” Rental
Increase Leads To
Long Dispute

WATER, LIGHT CUT
OFF BY WORKERS

Complainants’ Personal
Safety Said To Have
Been Threatened

A major victory for Shanghai
tenants in their attempt to
check ever-rising house rents
was believed to have been
achieved yesterday when the
First Special District Court de-
creed that employees of a British
realty firm had no right to cause
the eviction of a tenant by force.
The suit was brought by a Russian
tenant, Mrs. D. Hasser, of the Ascot
Apartment on Bubbling Well Road.
Her complaint was made against
employees of the British firm,
Brandt and Rodgers, Ltd., who, she
said, had intimidated her and her
daughter, damaged her property
and committed offenses against her
personal liberty.

Trial Concluded
Concluding the trial yesterday
morning, the Court sentenced the
three defendants to two months’
imprisonment, suspended for three
years. The defendants, J. Ifland,
V. Debrosky and V. Smirnov, were
hailed into court last week.
On the witness stand, Mrs. Hasser
related the story of how several
months past, the owners of the
apartment had made repeated at-
tempts to force her and her
daughter out of their apartment.
The trouble began late last win-
ter, Mrs. Hasser stated, when the
landlords demanded a 30 per cent
rent increase for her apartment.
She consented only to a 10 per cent
increase, she added.
The dispute subsequently reached
the Chinese court, she recalled, and
early in May, a judgment was given
in her favor.

Attempt Continued
Despite the judgment, Mrs. Hasser
continued, the British owners time
and again sought to dispossess her
and during the last three months,
they made life virtually unbearable
for both mother and daughter.
Toward the end of August,
the accused were alleged to have
threatened the safety of the
complainants and damaged their
property. Ifland, as superinten-
dent of the building, was said
to have hired the other two
defendants to keep the tenant
out of the apartment elevator
and to cut off her water and
light. She told the judge that
the electric wiring, cut off by
the defendants once before, had
been re-installed at her own
expense.

《大美晚报》
1939年9月28日

3名雇员
被判缓刑

“不合理”的租金
上涨导致
长期纠纷

工人切断
水电

称投诉人的人身
安全受到威胁

上海租户在试图遏制不断上涨的房屋租金方面被认为于昨日取得重大胜利，当时第一特区地方法院裁定，一家英国房地产公司的雇员无权通过武力驱逐租户。该诉讼由静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）阿斯科特公寓（Ascot Apartment）的俄罗斯租户 D. 哈瑟（D. Hasser）夫人提起。她的投诉针对的是英国公司 Brandt and Rodgers, Ltd. 的雇员，据称这些人恐吓了她和她的女儿，损坏了她的财产，并侵犯了她的人身自由。

审判结束
昨日上午结束审判时，法院判处三名被告有期徒刑两个月，缓刑三年。被告 J. 伊夫兰（J. Ifland）、V. 德布罗斯基（V. Debrosky）和 V. 斯米尔诺夫（V. Smirnov）于上周被传唤到庭。

在证人席上，哈瑟夫人讲述了几个月前公寓业主多次试图强迫她和女儿搬出公寓的故事。哈瑟夫人称，麻烦始于去年冬末，当时房东要求将她的公寓租金提高30%。她补充说，她只同意提高10%。

她回忆说，随后纠纷诉至中国法院，并于5月初作出了有利于她的判决。

企图持续
哈瑟夫人继续说道，尽管有了判决，英国业主仍一次次试图剥夺她的占有权，并在过去三个月里使母女俩的生活几乎无法忍受。

据称，8月底，被告威胁投诉人的安全并损坏其财产。据说，作为大楼管理员的伊夫兰雇佣了另外两名被告，阻止租户使用公寓电梯，并切断其水电供应。她告诉法官，此前被被告切断的电线已由她自己出资重新安装。

哈瑟夫人接着说，最近一次试图驱逐她的行动发生在9月19日，当时被告堵住了从她公寓引出的所有污水排放口。她补充说，这导致马桶溢出和浴室部分被淹。

事件叙述

25206

Realty Employees
Given Sentences

Water And Light Cut;
Harm Threatened
To Woman

Shanghai tenants at bitter war with their landlords over the ever-increasing house rents saw the initial victory in a test case awarded to one of their harassed members today.

The First Special District Court this morning meted out two months' imprisonment to each of three employees of a British real estate firm for making an eviction attempt on a Russian lady tenant. The sentence was suspended for three years, however.

The judgment was handed down on the ground that the three Russian employees had by means of violence and threats prevented the lady lessee of the firm's property from exercising her rights as a tenant.

Intimidation

The three men sentenced today were J. Ifland, V. Debrovsky and V. Smirnov, all employees of Messrs. Brandt and Rodgers, Ltd. The lawsuit had been brought against them by Mrs. D. Hasser on charges of intimidation, damage to property and offense against personal liberty.

Mrs. Hasser, who occupies Room 307B at the Ascot Apartments on Bubbling Well Road, accused Ifland, a caretaker, of cutting the electric and water supply to her room on August 15 because she had refused to agree to a 30 percent increase on the rent of the room. She said that she had agreed to pay any additional increase of only 10 percent.

Threats Of Harm

Following this Ifland is alleged to have made threats of bodily harm to both Mrs. Hasser and her daughter, Miss J. Hasser, should she fail to move out of the premises. Ifland was also accused of incurring damage to electric installations on the premises made by the lessee with her own money on August 25.

In addition to the threats made at her and the damage to her property, Ifland was also accused of hiring the other two defendants as watchmen for the express purpose of preventing her and Miss Hasser from using the apartment elevator. The two Russians and another one, who was recently dismissed, took up duty in front of the lift on August 18, it was alleged.

Messrs. Y. T. Van and E. L. Yui represented the plaintiff, while the defense lawyer was Mr. B. L. Radomishelsky.
pages.zh:
25206

房地产雇员
被判刑

断水断电；
威胁伤害
一名妇女

上海租户因房租不断上涨而与房东陷入激烈纠纷，今日，其中一名饱受困扰的租户在一起测试性案件中取得了初步胜利。

第一特区地方法院今早判处一家英国房地产公司的三名雇员各两个月监禁，原因是他们试图驱逐一名俄罗斯女租户。不过，刑期缓刑三年。

判决理由是，这三名俄罗斯雇员通过暴力和威胁手段，阻碍了该公司物业的女承租人行使其作为租户的权利。

恐吓

今日被判刑的三人是 J. Ifland、V. Debrovsky 和 V. Smirnov，均为 Brandt and Rodgers, Ltd.（音译）公司的雇员。D. Hasser 夫人对他们提起诉讼，指控其犯有恐吓、损坏财产和侵犯人身自由罪。

Hasser 夫人居住在静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）Ascot 公寓（音译）307B 室，她指控管理员 Ifland 于 8 月 15 日切断了其房间的水电供应，因为她拒绝同意将房租提高 30%。她说，她只同意支付额外 10% 的增幅。

伤害威胁

据称，在此之后，Ifland 威胁要对 Hasser 夫人及其女儿 J. Hasser 小姐进行人身伤害，如果她们不搬离该处所。Ifland 还被指控于 8 月 25 日损坏了由承租人自费安装的电力设施。

除了对她进行威胁和损坏其财产外，Ifland 还被指控雇佣另外两名被告担任看守，专门目的是阻止她和 Hasser 小姐使用公寓电梯。据称，这两名俄罗斯人和另一名最近被解雇的人于 8 月 18 日开始在电梯前执勤。

原告由 Y. T. Van 先生和 E. L. Yui 先生代理，辩护律师为 B. L. Radomishelsky 先生。

Eviction Fails
The trouble between Mrs.
Hasser and the real estate firm
began in April of this year when
the firm brought a suit against
her in the civil section of the
court in an effort to evict her
from the premises on her refusal
to recognize a 30-percent in-
crease on the rent. The court dis-
missed the case, overruling the
eviction injunction filed by the
real estate firm.
Although there have been
numerous cases involving tenants
and landlords, this is the first
time a jail term, though it was
suspended, has been given to re-
presentatives of landlords. This
heralds a strong stand on the
part of the Chinese judicial
authorities in regard to illegal
eviction measures adopted by
some of Shanghai's landlords
against their tenants. This at-
titude is interpreted as a protec-
tive measure to safeguard tenants
in preserving their legal rights of
possession.

252117

驱逐未遂

Hasser 夫人与房地产公司之间的纠纷始于今年四月，当时该公司在法院民事庭对她提起诉讼，试图将她从房屋中驱逐出去，因为她拒绝承认 30% 的租金涨幅。法院驳回了此案，否决了房地产公司提出的驱逐令。

虽然涉及租户和房东的案件 numerous（众多），但这是房东代表首次被判入狱，尽管是缓刑。这预示著中国司法当局对上海部分房东针对租户采取的非法驱逐措施采取强硬立场。这种态度被解读为保护租户维护其合法居住权的保护措施。

pages.en:
25346

British Lady Appealing
Against Eviction

Sues Landlord In Chinese Court For Demanding
Payment Of Rent In U.S. Currency; Latter
Will Retaliate In British Court

An interesting appeal case, filed by Mrs. J. Tyler, a British subject and tenant of the Brookside Apartment, 435, Avenue Haig, under the auspices of the Shanghai Tenants' Association, against Mr. Peter K. C. Lee, landlord, against payment of rentals in United States currency and against an eviction order was heard before Judge Hsia at the Third Branch Kiangsu High Court yesterday.

Messrs. Chow Liang-pu and D'Auxion de Ruffe appeared for the appellant, and Mr. T. C. Chen, for the defendant. Another case is also pending on October 5, at the British Supreme Court in which the plaintiff and the defendant will be reversed, although the legal issue will remain the same.

**Contract Valid Till 1940**

Neither party appeared in court yesterday, and the issue was contested by their counsel. M. D'Auxion de Ruffe maintained that the contract signed between Mrs. Taylor and the defendant would be valid until October 1, 1940, and that she could not be evicted until that date. He also contended that the defendant should not demand payment of rentals in U.S. dollars, instead of in Chinese national currency, as heretofore.

The law of France, M. D'Auxion de Ruffe cited as an example, provided that if France were at war with another country, no Frenchman could demand payment of rentals in other than French national currency, at the risk of a court-martial and execution. It was a great "loss of face" for any Chinese landlord to demand payment of rentals in foreign currencies, now that China was at war. M. D'Auxion de Ruffe also quoted the ruling of the Ministry of Finance of the Chinese National Government, promulgated in 1937, stating that all rentals should be paid in Chinese national currency and calculated on that basis during the period of national emergency.

**Rent Nearly Trebled**

Counsel for the appellant produced a contract, wherein, it was stated that the monthly rent was fixed at $175, but on June 26 last Mr. Lee served notice upon her, stating that, commencing from August 1, rentals would be fixed at U.S.$32.

The Judge, interposing, asked, "What is the difference between payment in Chinese currency and in American dollars?"

Appellant's counsel: "It amounts to $450 at the present rate of exchange, or a clear difference of $275 every month."

Mr. T. C. Chen, for the defendant, then contended that the contract stipulated that the landlord had to serve one month's notice upon the tenant before requesting evacuation. The tenant, too, had to notify the landlord before evacuating. Mr. Chow Liang-pu asked that great sympathy should be shown by the court against eviction orders in general, because it was difficult for tenant to find suitable living quarters.

The notice served by Mr. Peter Lee upon Mrs. Taylor on June 26, Mr. Chen contended, was in the nature of an offer. He contended that since there was no acceptance, Mrs. Taylor had to vacate the premises.

**Threatening Letter**

At this moment, M. D'Auxion de Ruffe rose from his seat and interposed, "The notice was in the form of an intimidation. The letter of June 26 was followed by another written on August 4, in which the landlord threatened to take action against my client in the British Court for China." The letter added that she would have to pay £10 for costs, equivalent to about C.$600. That was clearly designed to intimidate Mrs. Taylor, M. D'Auxion de Ruffe declared.

Since Mrs. Taylor did not agree to payment of rentals in American currency, she therefore did not see any need to reply to the letter of June 26, M. D'Auxion de Ruffe contended. Moreover, the contract would be valid until October 1, 1940.

**Contradictory Contract**

Appellant's counsel argued that the contract was contradictory in nature, for although the contract itself is valid until October 1, 1940, one section in it stipulated that both landlord and tenant should serve one month's notice before evacuation of the apartment.

**Lenient Court**

Mr. Chen alleged that Mrs. Taylor's motive in bringing the case before the Chinese court, and not before the British Court for China, was due to her desire to avail herself of extraterritorial rights, and because Chinese courts were usually more lenient to tenants.

The Judge: "But defendant is a Chinese."

Mr. Chen: "Yes, I do not mean that she has not taken the correct procedure. I only wanted to outline the general situation."

Counsel for the defence further maintained that the number of foreigners in Shanghai had not increased, in spite of the hostilities and the housing situation only affected the Chinese population. He pleaded that the electricity charges, coal prices and the costs of running the apartment had increased. Prices for these had therefore to be based upon foreign exchange and in terms of Chinese currency. Hence the requirement to pay rentals in American currency.

Judge Hsia ordered that an accurate translation of the letters that had passed between the defendant and Mrs. Taylor be submitted to the court tomorrow.

Judgment will be rendered at 3 p.m. on October 5, the same day that the trial will open at H. M. Supreme Court for China, when Mrs. Taylor will appear as defendant and Mr. Peter K. C. Lee as plaintiff.
pages.zh:
25346

英国女士上诉
反对驱逐

在中国法院起诉房东要求以美元支付租金；后者将在英国法院进行反击

昨日，江苏高等法院第三分院夏法官审理了一起有趣的上诉案。该案由英国籍人士、海格路（Avenue Haig）435 号 Brookside 公寓（音译）租户 J. Tyler 夫人，在上海租户协会的支持下，对房东 Peter K. C. Lee 先生提起，反对以美国货币支付租金及反对驱逐令。

Chow Liang-pu（周良甫，音译）先生和 D'Auxion de Ruffe 先生出庭代表上诉人，T. C. Chen 先生代表被告。另有一案也将于 10 月 5 日在英国最高法院待审，届时原告和被告身份将互换，但法律问题保持不变。

**合同有效期至 1940 年**

双方昨日均未出庭，由其律师进行辩论。D'Auxion de Ruffe 先生坚持认为，Taylor 夫人与被告签订的合同有效期至 1940 年 10 月 1 日，在此之前不得将其驱逐。他还主张，被告不应像以往那样要求以美元而非中国法币支付租金。

D'Auxion de Ruffe 先生援引法国法律为例指出，如果法国与另一国处于战争状态，任何法国人若要求以非法国法币支付租金，将面临军事法庭审判甚至死刑的风险。如今中国处于战争状态，任何中国房东要求以外币支付租金都是极大的“丢脸”行为。D'Auxion de Ruffe 先生还引用了中国国民政府财政部于 1937 年颁布的规定，指出在国家紧急时期，所有租金应以中国法币支付并以此为基础计算。

**租金几乎翻了三倍**

上诉人律师出示了一份合同，其中规定月租金固定为 175 美元，但去年 6 月 26 日，Lee 先生向她发出通知，称从 8 月 1 日起，租金将定为 32 美元（注：此处原文逻辑似有缺漏或指代不明，结合下文差额，可能原意为涨至某高额数值或单位不同，但依原文译出）。

法官插问道：“用法币支付和用美元支付有什么区别？”

上诉人律师：“按当前汇率计算，差额达 450 美元，即每月净差 275 美元。”

随后，代表被告的 T. C. Chen 先生辩称，合同规定房东在要求腾房前必须提前一个月通知租户。租户在搬离前也必须通知房东。周良甫先生请求法院对一般的驱逐令表现出极大的同情，因为租户很难找到合适的住所。

Chen 先生辩称，Peter Lee 先生于 6 月 26 日向 Taylor 夫人发出的通知性质上是一项要约。他主张，由于没有接受该要约，Taylor 夫人必须腾退房屋。

**威胁信**

此时，D'Auxion de Ruffe 先生从座位上站起来插话道：“该通知具有恐吓性质。6 月 26 日的信件之后，又有一封写于 8 月 4 日的信，房东在信中威胁要在英国在华法院对我的客户采取行动。”信中补充说，她必须支付 10 英镑的费用，约合中国法币 600 元。D'Auxion de Ruffe 先生宣称，这显然是为了恐吓 Taylor 夫人。

D'Auxion de Ruffe 先生主张，由于 Taylor 夫人不同意以美元支付租金，因此她认为没有必要回复 6 月 26 日的信件。此外，合同有效期至 1940 年 10 月 1 日。

**相互矛盾的合同**

上诉人律师辩称，该合同性质上存在矛盾，因为虽然合同本身有效期至 1940 年 10 月 1 日，但其中一条款规定，房东和租户在腾退公寓前均应提前一个月通知对方。

**宽大的法院**

Chen 先生指控，Taylor 夫人将案件提交中国法院而非英国在华法院的动机，是由于她希望利用治外法权，且中国法院通常对租户更为宽大。

法官：“但被告是中国人。”

Chen 先生：“是的，我并不是说她程序不当。我只是想概述一般情况。”

辩护律师进一步主张，尽管发生敌对行动，上海的外国人数量并未增加，住房状况仅影响中国人口。他恳请法庭考虑电费、煤价和公寓运营成本均已上涨。因此，这些价格必须基于外汇并以中国法币计算。故要求以美元支付租金。

夏法官命令于明日向法庭提交被告与 Taylor 夫人之间往来信件的准确译文。

判决将于 10 月 5 日下午 3 时宣判，同日英国在华最高法院也将开庭审理此案，届时 Taylor 夫人将作为被告，Peter K. C. Lee 先生将作为原告。

Action By Chinese
in British Court

A British tenant is prosecuting
her Chinese landlord this after-
noon in the Second District Court
....and is herself to be prosecuted
in the British Court on Wednes-
day.
Members and prospective mem-
bers of the Shanghai Tenants As-
sociation are watching these two
cases with great interest, especial-
ly as the general meeting to es-
tablish the association on its full
basis has been convened for Octo-
ber 11, and as the landlord con-
cerned has already lost one case
brought against him by a British
tenant.

No Foreign Currency
In this first case the landlord
was sued for trying to raise the
rent before a twelve-months' lease
had been completed and for de-
manding that rent be paid in US
dollars. The judge ruled in favor
of the tenant, stating that the
lease could not be broken in this
manner and that foreign cur-
rency not be charged. Interest in
today's case also lies in the pos-
sibility of a contempt of court
ruling.
Articles of Association and bye-
laws have been drawn up by the
inaugural committee of the Shang-
hai Tenants Association for sub-
mission to the first general meet-
ing. They are as follows:
1. The name of this association is
the Shanghai Tenants' Associa-
tion.
2. The number of members is un-
limited, and tenants of all na-
tionalities are eligible for elec-
tion.
3. The objects for which this As-
sociation is formed are:—
(a) To protect the interests of
tenants.
(b) To promote a better feeling
between tenant and landlord
and to act as a liaison be-
tween tenant and landlord.
(c) To obtain legal advice and
provide counsel for the de-
fense of members, if such
action is deemed necessary.
(d) To hire and employ all
classes of persons consider-
ed necessary for the proper
conduct of the Association,
and to pay to such em-
ployees, and to other per-
sons in return for services
rendered, salaries, wages or
gratuities.
(e) To promote and hold, either
alone or jointly with any
other association, club, or
persons, meetings for the
furthering of interests bene-
ficial to the Association.
(f) To establish, promote or as-
sist in establishing or pro-
moting and to subscribe to,
or Become a member of any
other association whose ob-
jects are similar in whole
or in part to the objects of
this Association.
(g) To invest and deal with
money of the Association
not immediately required
in such securities and in
such a manner as many
from time to time be de-
termined.
(h) To do all such other law-
ful things as are conducive
to the attainment of the ob-
jects of the Association.

MERCURY
1939
租户开始
法律斗争
25375

原告面临中国人在
英国法院的反诉

一位英国租户今天下午在第二特区地方法院起诉她的中国房东，而她本人将于周三在英国法院被起诉。

上海租户协会的成员及准成员正密切关注这两起案件，尤其是鉴于定于 10 月 11 日召开大会以正式成立该协会，且涉案房东此前已在一名英国租户对其提起的案件中败诉。

不使用外币

在第一起案件中，房东因试图在十二个月租期未满前提高租金，并要求以美元支付租金而被起诉。法官裁定租户胜诉，指出租约不能以这种方式解除，且不得收取外币。今日案件的另一关注点在于是否会出现藐视法庭的裁决。

上海租户协会筹备委员会已起草章程和细则，提交第一次全体会议审议。内容如下：
1. 本协会名称为上海租户协会。
2. 会员人数不限，所有国籍的租户均有资格当选。
3. 本协会成立之目的为：—
(a) 保护租户利益。
(b) 促进租户与房东之间的良好关系，并充当租户与房东之间的联络人。
(c) 获取法律建议，并在认为必要时为会员提供辩护 counsel（法律顾问/律师）。
(d) 雇用和聘请被认为对协会正常运作必要的各类人员，并向此类雇员及其他提供服务的人员支付薪水、工资或酬金。
(e) 单独或与其他协会、俱乐部或个人联合，举办旨在促进有利于协会利益的会议。
(f) 建立、促进或协助建立或促进，并加入或成为任何其他目标全部或部分与本协会目标相似的协会的会员。
(g) 以不时确定的方式，将协会暂不需要的资金投资于此类证券。
(h) 从事所有其他有助于实现协会目标的合法事项。

（批：Lil 6/10）

Executive Committee
4. The business of the Association shall be handled by an executive committee who will be elected at the first general meeting and thereafter at each annual general meeting.
5. The accounts of the Association shall be audited annually by a chartered accountant to be appointed by the Committee, and a balance sheet shall be presented at each Annual General Meeting.
6. Should it be necessary at any time to dissolve the Association, the funds standing to the credit of the Association, after defraying all expenses and the cost of liquidation shall be divided equally among those members in good standing at the date of dissolution.

RULES
1. All business of the Association shall be managed by an Executive Committee which shall be composed of a Chairman, an Honorary Treasurer, and seven other members, one of whom shall be vice-Chairman. The Committee shall have power to co-opt additional members at their discretion.
2. The composition of the Executive Committee shall be of members representing as many different nationals as possible.
3. Four members of the Committee shall form a quorum and the Chairman shall have the casting vote.

Application
4. Membership shall be by application and shall be approved by the Executive Committee who shall reserve the right to refuse admission, without assigning any reason.
5. Membership shall be confined to those tenants holding direct tenancy from landlords or their accredited representatives. Sub-tenants renting part of apartments or houses from persons who are themselves tenants shall not be eligible for membership.
6. Complaints of any description must be made in writing to the Secretary, giving all relevant details.
7. Every complaint will be given due consideration and a report of the decision will be sent to the complainant by the Committee, who will use their discretion as to the action, if any, to be taken.
8. The Entrance Fee shall be C.N.C. $10 and the annual subscription C.N.C. $10, payable on election Any member whose annual subscription is three months in arrear will automatically cease to be a member.

执行委员会
4. 本会事务由执行委员会处理，该委员会将在第一次全体会议上选出，此后在每次年度全体会议上选出。
5. 本会账目应由委员会委任的特许会计师每年审计一次，并在每次年度全体会议上提交资产负债表。
6. 如有必要在任何时候解散本会，本会名下的资金在支付所有费用及清算成本后，应平均分配给解散之日资格良好的会员。

规章
1. 本会所有事务由执行委员会管理，该委员会由一名主席、一名名誉司库及另外七名成员组成，其中一人为副主席。委员会有权自行决定增补成员。
2. 执行委员会的组成应尽可能代表不同国籍的成员。
3. 四名委员即构成法定人数，主席拥有决定性投票权。

申请
4. 入会须提出申请，并经执行委员会批准，委员会保留拒绝接纳的权利，且无需说明任何理由。
5. 会员资格仅限于直接从房东或其授权代表处承租的租户。从其他租户手中转租公寓或房屋部分空间的次承租人不具备入会资格。
6. 任何类型的投诉必须以书面形式向秘书提出，并提供所有相关细节。
7. 每一起投诉都将得到适当考虑，委员会将把决定报告发送给投诉人，并由委员会酌情决定是否采取以及采取何种行动。
8. 入会费为法币10元，年费为法币10元，于当选时缴纳。任何会员若拖欠年费达三个月，将自动丧失会员资格。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.

AUG 3 1939

Tenants Assoc'n.:
Meeting to be Held Soon

To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS"

SIR,—Let me assure your corres-
pondent and others of the same way
of thinking that the Shanghai Tenants
Association is far from being inactive,
but, on the contrary has been putting
in a great deal of hard work the
brunt of which has so far fallen on
the shoulders of a few willing work-
ers.

An Association of this nature re-
quires a great deal of organizing but
is now taking definite shape.
Memorandum of Association, Rules
and Bye-laws have been drawn up,
an entrance fee of $10 and a yearly
subscription of $10 decided on.

These dues to some may appear
excessive, but it must be borne in
mind, that with the enormous amount
of work involved it is necessary to
have our own office accommodation
and a paid staff to attend to all
matters of business. In addition to
this it is necessary to arrange for
legal advice and defence.

It is estimated that at least $1000
per month will be necessary to cover
expenses and we are therefore aiming
at a membership of 1000 of which
we already have 300.

The Association will be run by a
committee of nine, power to co-opt
and will be international in character.

So far one case has been fought
successfully in the Chinese Court,
another case is pending and defence
is being arranged for a case shortly
being brought before a foreign Court.

The first General Meeting of the
Association, will be held in the Union
Church Hall, Yuen Ming Yuen Road
at 5.30 p.m. on Wednesday, October
11th to which all interested tenants
are invited.

Admission cards will be mailed in
the course of the next few days to
all members. Others desiring to at-
tend are requested to apply in writ-
ing for cards to Mr. W. M. Macoustra,
Apartment 45, 1173 Bubbling Well
Road.

J. S. CHISHOLM.
Shanghai, Sept. 30.

《字林西报》

1939年8月3日

租户协会：
即将举行会议

致《字林西报》编辑先生

先生，——请让我向贵报那位持相同看法的通讯员及其他人士保证，上海租户协会远非无所作为，相反，它一直投入大量辛勤工作，迄今为止，这些重担主要落在少数热心工作者的肩上。

此类协会需要大量的组织工作，但目前已初具雏形。协会备忘录、规章及附则已起草完毕，入会费定为10美元，年费定为10美元。

这些费用对某些人来说可能显得过高，但必须记住，鉴于涉及的工作量巨大，有必要拥有自己的办公场所以及受薪职员来处理所有业务事宜。此外，还需要安排法律咨询和辩护服务。

据估计，每月至少需要1000美元来支付开支，因此我们的目标是发展1000名会员，目前已有300名。

协会将由一个九人委员会管理，拥有增补成员的权力，并具有国际性质。

迄今为止，已在中国法院成功胜诉一案，另一案正在审理中，并正为即将提交外国法院审理的一案安排辩护。

协会第一次全体会议将于10月11日（星期三）下午5时30分在圆明园路联合教堂大厅举行，欢迎所有感兴趣的租户参加。

入场券将在未来几天内邮寄给所有会员。其他希望出席者，请以书面方式向威海卫路1173号45室 W. M. Macoustra 先生索取入场券。

J. S. CHISHOLM
上海，9月30日

The Rent Racket:
And those Surcharges

To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS"

SIR,—With reference to the letter in
your correspondence column this
morning signed L.J.S. and to the
notice on the first page—top left hand
corner—it would be interesting to
know just how much the Revenue
Department of the French Municipal
Council have derived in taxes from
all the "increases" which tenants of
the firm in question have had inflict-
ed on them in the recent five months?
I should imagine the manager of the
firm in question is going around with
an "is my face red" expression since
the appearance of that notice!

I have seen a couple of circular
letters sent out by the firm in ques-
tion and in relation to the subject of
heating charges, would like to ask
if it is not the understanding of ten-
ants in general when they lease an
apartment that the charge for heating
included in the monthly rental is to
cover the five winter months and
that it is averaged out monthly to
suit the landlord? There are some
of the firm in question who had a
surcharge of $30 included on their
monthly bills last winter for the
winter months but this surcharge
was not deducted when the winter
finished. The charge this winter is
to be $50 per month (at least for the
first three months of the cold wea-
ther) and it would be interesting to
know if this amount is to be deducted
or not?

The sixth paragraph of L.J.S.'s
letter suggests that the increased costs
should be borne equally by tenants
and landlords—vain hope! The gen-
eral idea of landlords—both of apart-
ment houses and boarding houses
alike—seems to be "we must not lose
any money. We must obtain the
same amount as we did before prices
went haywire"—and to that end seem
bent on milching the public until
"the stream runs dry." How long is
it going to take these worthy beings
to realize that most of us earn our
salaries in Chinese dollars—that a
chosen few only earn gold dollar and
sterling salaries? Whilst admitting
that most of us are in receipt of an
"high cost of living allowance" never-
theless I venture to suggest that that
allowance is not sufficient in some
cases to cover the increased costs we
are going to be faced with now that
winter has arrived, as witness the
latest surcharge—80 per cent. for the
Gas Company. If the Japanese and
the Chinese don't "freeze" us out of
here—the landlords will!

Here's to the Tenant's Association!
May it live long and rule wisely!

FAIRNESS.
Shanghai, Sept. 30.

25328

租金勒索：
以及那些附加费

致《字林西报》编辑先生

先生，——关于今早贵报读者来信栏中署名为 L.J.S. 的信件以及头版左上角的通告，令人感兴趣的是，想知道法国公董局税务局从涉事公司租户在最近五个月内被迫承受的所有“涨价”中征收了多少税款？我想，自该通告刊登以来，涉事公司的经理脸上大概一直挂着“羞愧难当”的表情！

我曾看到涉事公司发出的几封通函，就取暖费问题，我想请问，一般租户在租赁公寓时的理解难道不是月租中包含的取暖费应涵盖五个冬季月份，并且为了迎合房东而按月平均分摊吗？涉事公司的一些租户在去年冬季的月度账单中被列入了30美元的冬季月份附加费，但冬季结束后并未扣除这笔附加费。今年冬季的费用将是每月50美元（至少在寒冷天气的前三个月），令人感兴趣的是，这笔金额届时是否会扣除？

L.J.S. 信件的第六段暗示，增加的成本应由租户和房东平等承担——这真是空想！房东们（无论是公寓还是寄宿房屋的房东）的普遍想法似乎是“我们不能亏钱。我们必须获得与物价飞涨之前相同的金额”——为此，他们似乎决心榨取公众，直到“涓滴不剩”。这些可敬的人士还要多久才能意识到，我们大多数人的薪水是以中国货币支付的——只有少数被选中的人赚取金美元和英镑薪水？虽然承认我们大多数人领取“高额生活津贴”，但我冒昧建议，在某些情况下，该津贴不足以覆盖我们现在随着冬季到来而面临的增加成本，煤气公司最新的80%附加费即为明证。如果日本人和中国人没有把我们“冻”出这里——房东们也会！

为租户协会干杯！愿它长存并明智地治理！

FAIRNESS
上海，9月30日

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS

SEP 10

Rent Racket:
Correspondent Asks Questions

To the Editor of the
NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS

SIR, What has become of the
Shanghai Tenants Association? Since
the postponed mass meeting little
has been heard of what promised to
be the saviour of the Shanghai
tenants. That this association is as
necessary now as at any other time,
and most certainly in a permanent
form in the future, is borne out by
an ultimatum sent to tenants in
houses on Amherst Avenue by the
landlords. The rent of these houses
prior to the outbreak of the local
hostilities was $81.59 and since that
time an increase of $20 was accepted
by the tenants. We have now been
informed that our rental will be
payable in U.S.$7 or equivalent,
which at the rate of $17 local
currency, come to $6.20 i.e. an
increase of $17 on pre-hostility
rentals. Tenants apply their own
fuel and water, and pay rates,
electric power and gas charges, so
that none of the argument put for-
ward in a contributed article in
your paper some time ago, as being
the case for the landlords, has any
bearing in this particular case. This
is a further flagrant case of the type
of callous landlord we have in
Shanghai.

The decision handed down by the
Second District Court recently that
Chinese nationals could not charge
rentals in foreign currencies has been
overcome by Chinese landlords
tenturing the transfer of their owner-
ship to noted foreign land agencies.
This, however, deceives no one,
except probably themselves.

While we appreciate to some extent
the nice motives of those concerned
for postponing the mass meeting of
Shanghai Tenants, yet this is no time
for "kid glove" action. We have
heard from various sources of what
is going to be done, but as yet no
action to safeguard tenants is forth-
coming.

The war in Europe affects most of
us in Shanghai, but, so also does the
local landlord fraternity, and there-
fore we suggest that an early date
be decided for that much-needed
mass meeting of tenants so that
the Association can be put into
immediate action to combat, in every
honourable way, the crude and ques-
tionable methods of some of our
landlords.

A TENANT.
Shanghai, Sept. 9.

（批：10/9）

《字林西报》

9月10日

租金勒索：
通讯员提出问题

致《字林西报》编辑先生

先生，上海租户协会怎么了？自从那次推迟的群众大会以来，鲜有听闻这个曾有望成为上海租户救星的组织有何动静。该协会现在像以往任何时候一样必要，而且将来肯定需要以永久形式存在，这一点由房东向阿美士德路（Amherst Avenue）房屋租户发出的最后通牒所证实。这些房屋在当地敌对行动爆发前的租金为81.59美元，此后租户接受了20美元的涨幅。现在我们获悉，我们的租金将以7美元或等值的美金支付，按当地货币17元的汇率计算，合6.20美元，即比敌对行动前的租金增加了17美元。租户自行供应燃料和水，并支付捐税、电费和煤气费，因此，贵报此前一篇投稿文章中提出的支持房东的理由，在此特定案件中完全不适用。这是我们在上海遇到的冷酷无情房东类型的又一公然案例。

第二特区法院最近作出的华人不得以外币收取租金的裁决，已被中国房东通过将所有权转让给知名外国地产代理行所规避。然而，这骗不了任何人，恐怕除了他们自己。

虽然我们在一定程度上赞赏有关各方推迟上海租户群众大会的良好动机，但现在不是采取“温和”行动的时候。我们从各种渠道听说了将要采取的行动，但截至目前，尚未出现保障租户权益的具体行动。

欧洲战争影响了我们在上海的大多数人，但本地房东阶层也是如此，因此我们建议尽早确定那次迫切需要的租户群众大会的日期，以便协会能够立即采取行动，以一切正当方式对抗某些房东的粗暴和可疑手段。

一名租户
上海，9月9日

（批：10/9）

CHINA PRESS

SEP 9 1933

Meeting Set
For Tuesday
On Rent Issue

In pursuance with its recent decision to assume the task of forming a rent adjustment committee in Shanghai, the General Chamber of Commerce will hold a committee organizing meeting Tuesday afternoon.

The decision to sponsor such an arbitration board was communicated by the General Chamber to the Shanghai Municipal and the French Municipal Councils Thursday and was made as a result of a request by those two bodies some weeks ago.

The rent adjustment committee was first envisioned by the British Residents' Association about a month ago after it had become apparent that landlords particularly in the residential sections of the city were making exhorbitant demands on their tenants as a result of the sudden drop in the Chinese dollar. Not only were rents pushed up unreasonably but they were demanded in foreign currencies and in some cases landlords asked for three years' advance payment.

The S.M.C. in co-operation with the F. M. C. took the matter of forming an arbitration board under advisement but finally decided that the matter should be referred to a less official body in view of the fact that impartiality in any possible findings must be absolutely unquestioned.

《大美晚报》

1933年9月9日

周二将举行
关于租金问题
的会议

根据近期关于承担在上海组建租金调整委员会任务的决定，上海总商会将于周二下午举行委员会组织会议。

总商会已于周四向上海工部局和法国公董局通报了赞助此类仲裁机构的决定，此举是应上述两个机构数周前的请求而作出的。

租金调整委员会的概念最初由英国居留民团在大约一个月前提出，当时明显看出，由于中国货币突然贬值，房东（特别是城市住宅区的房东）向租户提出了过分的要求。不仅租金被不合理地推高，而且要求以外币支付，在某些情况下，房东甚至要求预付三年租金。

上海工部局与法国公董局合作，对组建仲裁机构一事进行了审议，但最终决定，鉴于任何可能的裁决结果必须绝对无可置疑地保持公正，此事应移交一个非官方机构处理。

SEP 9 1939

Rent Adjustment
The outbreak of war with its tremendous world problems and anxieties has tended to thrust local communal issues into the shade for the time being but it is encouraging to learn that definite action has been taken towards ameliorating the high rent condition in Shanghai. The General Chamber of Commerce, with commendable public spirit, has accepted the suggestion of the Shanghai Municipal Council and the French Concession to create a Rental Adjustment Committee, and it is expected that the new committee will soon begin to function. The situation has shown little improvement in recent weeks, although certain legal definition to payment of rents in foreign currencies has been given. Through external circumstances principally based on the depreciation of sterling in relation to U.S. dollar owing to the European war, the Chinese dollar has assumed kangaroo-like momentum, but it has had no influence on the rent question. It is too early to suggest precisely what form of action the new committee will take, but it is believed that it will act in the nature of an arbitration board to suggest a fair economic limit in proportion to investments represented in property and a fair return in the way of rents. As most of Shanghai's house and apartment dwellers are grouped together in regard to rents, the committee's task should not be unusually difficult, although, of course, the acceptance of their suggestions remains to be seen. The general public has very solidly and definitely expressed its views on the question, and if the committee is able to adjust matters it will have contributed a great piece of public service to the welfare of a community like Shanghai caught in the toils of exchange and a depreciated dollar.

1939年9月9日

租金调整

战争的爆发及其带来的巨大世界性问题和焦虑，暂时使地方社区问题黯然失色，但令人鼓舞的是，为改善上海的高租金状况已采取具体行动。上海总商会本着值得称赞的公共精神，接受了上海工部局和法租界的建议，成立租金调整委员会，预计新委员会将很快开始运作。尽管对外币支付租金已有某些法律界定，但近几周局势鲜有改善。由于欧洲战争导致英镑相对于美元贬值等外部因素，中国货币呈现出袋鼠般的跳跃式波动，但这并未对租金问题产生影响。现在推测新委员会将采取何种具体行动形式还为时过早，但人们相信，它将发挥仲裁机构的作用，建议一个与房产投资相称的公平经济限度，以及合理的租金回报。由于上海大多数房屋和公寓居住者在租金问题上处境相似，委员会的任务不应异常艰巨，当然，其建议能否被接受仍有待观察。公众已非常坚定明确地表达了对此问题的看法，如果委员会能够调整此事，将为像上海这样陷入汇率困境和货币贬值泥潭的社区的福祉做出巨大的公共服务贡献。

Japanese Opposed to
Rent Increases

Pearce Apartment Society
Now Formed

Organizing to fight an increase of
about 50 per cent. in their rents,
most of the residents of the Pearce
Apartments, Chapoo and Boone

regulations governing the apartments,

CHINA PRESS.

AUG 25 1939

Rent Payers
Here To Meet
On Wednesday

Opinions On Proposed
Adjustment Body
Sought

The rent problem of Shanghai, which has been obscured during the past few days by other high living cost and political questions here, came to the fore yesterday with a report that the General Chamber of Commerce has circulated a letter among its members asking their opinion on a proposed "Rent Adjustment Committee" which is looked on favorably by the S.M.C.

At the same time it was learned that the Shanghai Tenants' Association will hold a mass meeting, postponed last week, on Wednesday at 5:15 p.m. in the Union Church Hall, 218 Yuen Ming Yuen Road.

The Association which was formed only two weeks ago will elect officers and hear propositions on how to carry on its fight against unscrupulous landlords. The question of financing will also be discussed at this meeting.

While the Chinese dollar has continued to decline during the past weeks causing landlords to revise their rents upward with added speed as the lease signing period of September approaches, a new "racket" has been devised evidently in the hope of appeasing public disgust with the current practice of demanding rent payment in foreign currency.

Instead of the former demand for "key money" and U.S. currency, some landlords now advertise a small monthly rental and no "key money" but three years advance payment. If the tenant should depart Shanghai or this life before his lease is up the landlord stands to profit by a large sum of money.

（批：Raf 26/8）

这里的租金支付者

调整机构的意见

过去几天，上海租金问题被当地其他高昂生活成本和政治问题所掩盖，但随着一则消息传出，该问题昨日再次成为焦点。消息称，上海总商会已在会员中散发信函，征询他们对拟议成立的“租金调整委员会”的意见，工部局对该委员会持赞成态度。

与此同时，获悉上海租户协会将于周三下午5时15分在圆明园路218号联合教堂大厅举行上周推迟的大会。

该协会仅于两周前成立，将在会上选举职员，并听取关于如何继续对抗无良房东的建议。会议还将讨论经费筹措问题。

尽管在过去几周内法币持续贬值，导致随着九月签约期的临近，房东们以更快速度上调租金，但显然有人设计出一种新的“敲诈手段”，希望能平息公众对目前要求以外币支付租金做法的反感。

一些房东不再像以前那样要求“顶费”和美元，而是刊登广告，标示较低的月租金且不收“顶费”，但要求预付三年租金。如果租户在租约期满前离开上海或去世，房东将从中获利一大笔钱。

CHINA PRESS.

Rent Payers' Meet Postponed
Due To Political Tension Here

Political tension in Shanghai during the past week reached a point yesterday where the newly formed Tenants' Association decided to postpone their mass meeting scheduled for today, in the interest of public welfare.

The local political situation vis-a-vis the "ta tao" government and the impending rice famine, it was stated, were considered sufficiently intricate problems to be solved at the time by the Municipal authorities, without injecting the further acute situation of abnormal rents into the picture. The meeting will probably be held next week.

No word had been received yet from the British Residents' Association on their proposed meeting tomorrow night to discuss the same problem, it was learned.

The Shanghai Tenants' Association was formed Friday night following a meeting of representatives from ten apartment houses here in protest against endlessly increasing rents throughout the city and the demands by landlords that bills be paid in foreign currency or the equivalent.

The Union Church Hall on Soochow Road will be the scene of the mass meeting. Officers of the Association will be elected during the conclave and some definite policy formulated for coping with the rent "racket" here. It is hoped that a representative of the Landlords' Association will be present to give the other side of the picture.

《大美晚报》。

因本地政治紧张
租金支付者会议延期

上周上海的政治紧张局势在昨日达到一定程度，出于公共福利考虑，新成立的租户协会决定推迟原定于今天举行的大会。

据悉，鉴于本地政治局势涉及“大道”政府以及迫在眉睫的米荒，这些问题被认为足够复杂，应由市政当局在当时解决，而不应再将租金异常这一尖锐局势卷入其中。会议可能会在下周举行。

据悉，尚未收到英国居民协会关于其提议于明晚举行会议讨论同一问题的任何消息。

上海租户协会于周五晚成立，此前本市十栋公寓楼的代表举行会议，抗议全市租金无休止上涨以及房东要求以外币或等值货币支付账单的要求。

苏州路上的联合教堂大厅将成为大会的举办地。协会官员将在会议期间选举产生，并将制定一些明确的政策以应对本地的租金“敲诈”。希望业主协会的代表能出席，以提供另一方的观点。

pages.en:
ON A PRESS
2 / 15

Mass Meeting
Planned For
Near Future

New Association Will
Be Open To Every
Nationality

BRITISH CHAMBER
IS ALSO ACTIVE

Definite Action On
Rental Problem
Foreseen

The tenant-landlord battle
which has raged through
Shanghai's courts and public
prints for more than a month
now, entered a new phase of
action yesterday with news that
foreign groups are organizing a
tenant association to combat
unfair rent boosts.

The Shanghai Tenants' Associa-
tion formed of apartment and
business house occupants was
formally launched to protect ten-
ants of every nationality from
landlords who are taking advant-
age of the present abnormal con-
ditions.

Less definite but just as purpose-
ful are the plans of the British
Residents Association which this
week approached the British Cham-
ber of Commerce with the idea of
joint action on the rent problem. A
meeting of the Chamber will be
held this week further to discuss
possibilities.

Hongkew Discontented

Concurrently with the French and
International Settlement rumblings
news came yesterday that Chinese
tenants in certain parts of Hong-
kew have refused to pay increased
rents and that the Japanese Press
Club in the Pearce Apartments,
Hongkew filed a protest along with
other tenants against 50 per cent
increases.

In the meantime increasingly
numerous opinions have come from
the legal fraternity affirming the
powers of the Municipal Council to
regulate unfair rent practices. Al-
though there is no ruling defining
the Council's powers in such affairs,
it is pointed out that neither has
the body any definite powers to
raise a Volunteer Corps or to operate
a municipal orchestra. These
matters come under the head of
public welfare. Similarly it is
pointed out that if the worst comes
in matters of emergency such as
the present, H.B.M. Consul would
have the power to issue a King's
Regulation establishing a maximum
rent.

The Shanghai Tenants' Associa-
tion was launched Friday evening
attended by representatives of the
Brookside, Garden, Medhurst,
Bubbling Well, Fonchin, I.S.S.
Apartments, Grosvenor House and
Embankment Buildings. The de-
cision of those present that such an
organization was necessary, appear-
ed unanimous.
pages.zh:
新闻发布
2 / 15

计划于
近期举行
大会

新协会将向
所有国籍开放

英国商会
也在积极行动

预计将对
租金问题采取
明确行动

租户与房东之间的斗争已在上海的法庭和公开报刊上激烈持续了一个多月，昨日随着外国团体正在组织租户协会以对抗不公平租金上涨的消息传来，进入了行动的新阶段。

由公寓和商业楼宇 occupant（住户/租客）组成的上海租户协会正式成立，旨在保护所有国籍的租户免受利用当前异常状况牟利的房东的侵害。

英国居民协会的计划虽不那么明确，但同样目的明确。该协会本周接触了英国商会，提议就租金问题采取联合行动。商会将于本周举行会议，进一步讨论各种可能性。

虹口不满情绪

与此同时，继法租界和公共租界的动荡消息之后，昨日传来消息说，虹口某些地区的中国租户已拒绝支付增加的租金，且虹口皮尔斯公寓的日本记者俱乐部与其他租户一起，对50%的涨幅提出了抗议。

在此期间，法律界人士越来越多的意见证实了工部局监管不公平租金行为的权力。虽然尚无裁决界定工部局在此类事务中的权力，但有人指出，该机构也没有明确的权力去组建万国商团或运营市政管弦乐队。这些事项属于公共福利范畴。同样有人指出，如果在如当前的紧急情况下事态恶化，英国驻华领事有权发布国王谕令，设定最高租金限额。

上海租户协会于周五晚启动，出席者包括布鲁克赛德（Brookside）、花园（Garden）、麦赫斯特（Medhurst）、静安寺路（Bubbling Well）、丰陈（Fonchin）、国际储蓄社（I.S.S.）公寓、格罗夫纳大厦（Grosvenor House）和外滩大楼（Embankment Buildings）的代表。与会者认为此类组织是必要的，这一决定似乎是一致的。

pages.en:
Two resolutions passed at the
conclave declared:
1—This Association is being
formed in the interests of all
tenants of every nationality to pro-
tect them from the action of those
landlords who are taking advantage
of the present abnormal conditions
to demand excessive and unwar-
ranted increases in rentals, which
action is putting an unbearable load
on the residents of Shanghai and
thereby jeopardizing the economic
structure of this city.
2—To act as a liaison between
tenant and landlord.

Mass Meeting Planned

Negotiations are at present in
progress for obtaining a meeting
hall for a forthcoming mass meet-
ing. The Property Owners' As-
sociation will be asked to have a re-
presentative present at this meet-
ing.
The meeting closed Friday even-
ing with a hearty vote of thanks
to Mr. Carroll Alcott, well-known
local news commentator, for his
timely addresses on the rental
situation in Shanghai, made over
station XMHA.
The first fruits of Shanghai
tenants' agitation for fair treat-
ment from landlords came yester-
day with the announcement that
a large property holder who re-
cently had asked that his future
rents must be paid in Sterling, has
now voluntarily offered to reduce
increases by 20 per cent. and
accept payment in local currency.
The arrangement would be subject
to tri monthly adjustment accord-
ing to the trend of the money
market.
The rent problem in Shanghai
has been a problem only since the
1937 hostilities here which forced
thousands of refugees into the
Settlement and filled all available
dwellings many of which had pre-
viously been empty.
Taking advantage of their
monopoly of the housing situation
landlords have gradually increased
their rents over the two year period
because of currency fluctuation
and higher maintenance costs. In
some cases the rents have been
exactly double since 1937.
pages.zh:
会议上通过的两项决议声明：
1—本协会的成立是为了所有国籍租户的利益，保护他们免受那些利用当前异常状况要求过度且无正当理由增加租金的房东的行为侵害，这种行为给上海居民带来了难以承受的负担，从而危及本市的经济结构。
2—充当租户与房东之间的联络人。

计划举行大会

目前正在进行谈判，以获取即将举行的大会的会场。将邀请业主协会派代表出席此次会议。
会议于周五晚结束，并向当地知名新闻评论员卡罗尔·奥尔科特（Carroll Alcott）先生致以热烈的谢意，感谢他通过XMHA电台就上海租金局势发表的及时讲话。
上海租户争取房东公平对待的抗争昨日初显成效，一位最近要求其未来租金必须以英镑支付的大型物业持有者宣布，现自愿将涨幅降低20%，并接受以本地货币支付。该安排将根据货币市场趋势每三个月调整一次。
上海的租金问题自1937年本地战事以来才成为一个问题，战事迫使成千上万难民进入租界，填满了所有可用的住所，其中许多此前一直空置。
房东利用其对住房局势的垄断地位，在过去两年中因货币波动和维护成本上升而逐渐提高租金。在某些情况下，自1937年以来租金正好翻了一番。

pages.en:
Panicky Landlords
With destabilization of the Chinese dollar in early July, the landlords became panicky. Prices were hiked throughout the city quite out of proportion to the drop in the dollar. But the fact which crystalized an uncoordinated antagonism into pleas for mass action, came when a Chinese landlord, Mr. Peter Li, demanded, besides a rent boost, that payment be made on a U.S. currency basis.
Immediately an association was formed in the affected apartment house and the matter was taken to court where M. d'Auxion de Ruffe, well known French attorney here, labelled the Chinese landlord's demand as tantamount to treason for daring to demand payment in a foreign currency.
In the meantime the "Ta Tao" mayor of Greater Shanghai, Mr. Fu Siao-en, wrote a letter to the Sin Jihun Pao Chinese language daily on July 25, demanding that the Settlement authorities take action on behalf of the poorer Chinese and prohibit both the unfair rent boost and payment in other than Chinese money.
The situation has been unduly aggravated by the fact that while rents here have been mounting with the rapidity of other food and living costs, salaries of those paid on a Chinese currency basis have latterly been increased by a fraction only of their just proportion.
Although it has been insinuated that the S.M.C. has done nothing so far to attempt an adjustment in rentals because of the higher sums received from ratepayers in consequence, it is probable that the council will shortly be forced to take definite action.
pages.zh:
惊慌失措的房东

随着七月初中国法币（Chinese dollar）汇率的不稳，房东们变得惊慌失措。全市范围内的物价上涨幅度与法币贬值的幅度完全不成比例。但是，将这种缺乏协调的敌对情绪转化为要求采取集体行动的呼声的决定性事件，是一位中国房东李彼得（Peter Li，音译）先生除了要求提高租金外，还要求以美元为基础支付租金。

受影响的公寓楼内立即成立了一个协会，并将此事诉诸法庭。在此地颇有名气的法国律师德奥克西翁·德·鲁夫（M. d'Auxion de Ruffe，音译）先生将该中国房东的要求斥为等同于叛国，因为他竟敢要求以外币支付租金。

与此同时，大上海“大道政府”市长傅筱庵先生于7月25日致函中文日报《新日报》（Sin Jihun Pao，音译），要求租界当局代表较贫困的中国人采取行动，禁止不公平的租金上涨以及禁止使用非中国货币支付租金。

鉴于此地的租金随着其他食品和生活成本的快速上涨而飙升，而以中国货币领取薪水者的薪资近期仅按正当比例的一小部分增加，这一事实使得局势被过度激化。

尽管有人暗示，工部局（S.M.C.）迄今为止未尝试调整租金，是因为由此从纳税人那里收到了更高的款项，但理事会很可能很快将被迫采取明确行动。

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS,

AUG 20 1934

Tenants Organize
Association

Mass Meeting Planned in
Near Future ; Undue Rent
Increases Opposed

The Shanghai Tenants' Associa-
tion was successfully launched on
Friday evening, when representa-
tives of Brookside, Garden, Med-
hurst, Bubbling Well, Foncim, I.S.S.
Apartments, Grosvenor House, and
Embankment Buildings met to dis-
cuss the advisability of forming
such an association. The decision
that an association was necessary at
the present time was unanimous.
It was resolved:—(a) This Asso-
ciation is being formed in the in-
terests of all tenants of every na-
tionality to protect them from the
action of those landlords who are
taking advantage of the present
abnormal conditions to demand ex-
cessive and unwarranted increases
in rentals, which action is putting
an unbearable load on the resi-
dents of Shanghai and thereby
jeopardizing the economic structure
of this city. (b) To act as a liaison
between tenant and landlord.
Negotiations are at present pro-
ceeding for obtaining a suitable
hall, for the purpose of holding a
mass meeting of tenants of every
nationality.
At this meeting it is intended to
ask the Property Owners Associa-
tion to send a representative to ad-
dress the meeting, with a view
to explaining the reasons for the
enormous increase in rentals, and to
state why rentals are being de-
manded in foreign currencies. It is
hoped that arrangements may be
made for a well known and respected
local citizen to preside at the meet-
ing.
The question of dues to the asso-
ciation was shelved for discussion
at the mass meeting of tenants, but
as funds are urgently required,
voluntary donations, however small,
will be welcomed, and may be
sent to Mr. W. M. Macoustra, 45,
Garden Apartments, 1173, Bubbling
Well Road.
It was stated at the meeting that
a large firm of property owners,
who were demanding rentals in
U.S. dollars and sterling had, due
to the agitation of their tenants,
voluntary offered to reduce their
demanded increases by twenty per
cent., and charge in local currency,
such an arrangement to be subject
to revision every three months, when
rents would be adjusted up or
down according to the operating
expenses then ruling for a further
period of three months.
The meeting closed with a hearty
vote of thanks to Mr. Carroll Alcott
for his timely addresses on the
rental situation over radio station
XMHA.

租户组织
协会

计划在近期举行
群众大会；反对
不当涨租

上海租户协会于周五晚上成功成立，当时布鲁克赛德（Brookside，音译）、花园公寓（Garden Apartments）、麦特赫斯特（Medhurst，音译）、静安寺路（Bubbling Well，即今南京西路）公寓、丰辛（Foncim，音译）、国际礼拜堂宿舍（I.S.S. Apartments）、格罗夫纳大楼（Grosvenor House，音译）以及外滩大楼（Embankment Buildings，音译）的代表齐聚一堂，讨论成立此类协会的可行性。大家一致决定，在当前时期成立一个协会是必要的。

会议决议：—(a) 本协会的成立旨在维护所有国籍租户的利益，保护他们免受那些利用当前异常状况要求过度且无理提高租金的房东的行为侵害，这种行为给上海居民带来了难以承受的负担，从而危及本市的经济结构。(b) 充当租户与房东之间的联络人。

目前正在进行谈判，以争取获得一个合适的会场，用于举行各国籍租户参加的群众大会。

在此次大会上，拟请业主协会（Property Owners Association）派代表向大会发表讲话，解释租金大幅上涨的原因，并说明为何要求以外币支付租金。希望能安排一位知名且受尊敬的本地市民主持此次会议。

关于向协会缴纳会费的问题已暂缓，留待租户群众大会讨论，但由于急需资金，欢迎自愿捐款，无论金额大小，并可寄至静安寺路1173号花园公寓45号的W. M. Macoustra（音译）先生收。

会上指出，一家大型业主公司此前要求以美元和英镑支付租金，由于租户的抗议，该公司自愿提出将其要求的涨幅降低百分之二十，并以本地货币收取租金，该安排每三个月修订一次，届时租金将根据当时通行的运营费用进行上调或下调，为期再续三个月。

会议在热烈感谢卡罗尔·奥尔科特（Carroll Alcott，音译）先生通过XMHA广播电台就租金问题及时发表讲话中结束。
