CHINA PRESS

AUG 19 1939

Rent Increase
Is Protested
By Japanese

The Shanghai Japanese Press
Club, which has its headquarter, in
the Pearce Apartments in Hongkew,
Thursday afternoon filed a protest
with Mr. A. W. Buck, manager of
the Shanghai Land Investment Co.
Ltd., against a 50 per cent increase
in rent.
The protest stated that the club
would not pay the rent until the
company had come to an under-
standing. Other tenants of the
apartment building had joined them
in fighting the rent increase, the
protest said.
This action of the company, the
protest declared, would lead to a
wholesale rise of rents in Hongkew
and thus work a serious hardship
on Japanese residents.

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS

AUG 19 1939

Tenants Refuse to
Pay Rent

Tongshan Road Residents
Live at Half Rent for a
Period of Seven Months

Taking advantage of the general
antipathy towards landlords in the
International Settlement and French
Concession, the tenants of the Shang-
hai Land Investment Company's pro-
perty in Tongshan Road, who had
been living in the few blocks of
small houses and shops at half rent,
have objected to the company's
request for full rent and have refused
to pay any rent at all. Consequently,
the company has shut off the water
supply to all the houses.

Before the outbreak of hostilities
in Shanghai on August 13, 1937,
rents on the Tongshan Road property
were quoted at $18 and $19 per
month for small houses and shops.
When the evacuation of the district
occurred after the outbreak of the
war here, the company decided to
increase the rent of both houses and
shops to $23 per month, if the tenants
ever desired to move back to the
area.

In February, 1938, such a move-
ment began and about 20 per cent.
of the dwellings were occupied by
tenants who had moved back to their
old homes and who lived there rent
free. There was no water supplied
to the houses at the time, consequent-
ly the company permitted the tenants
to live there rent free. As more and
more people took up residence in
the block the company was moved,
in November, 1937, to charge tenants
half of the new rent decided upon
and to supply water to the tenants at
intervals of three times a day.

Request of Tenants

This was done at the request of
the tenants, who had formerly been
getting water from hydrants outside
the Japanese Naval Landing Party
Barracks. The company stipulated
that if the water was turned on the
tenants would have to pay half of
the new rent, or $11.50 per month.
At the time the company did not feel
justified in charging full rent because
there was no light provided for the
lanes and alleyways.

Last month, however, the company
was able to supply water freely 24
hours a day, had turned on the lights
in the lanes and alleyways and
provided a Russian watchman for the
property. They then sent a circular
letter around to all tenants stating
that as conditions had more or less
returned to normal and that as the
company was supplying water with
no restrictions the tenants would be
requested to pay full rent, or $23
per month for their houses or shops.

Immediately the tenants construed
this move as a demand for an in-
crease of 100 per cent. over the rent
they had been paying and refused
to accede to the company's request.
In reality, however, it was merely
an addition of 50 per cent. to the
half they had been paying, thus
making the rent 100 per cent. or $23
per month. Even this figure re-
presents an increase of only 25 per
cent. over the rent they had been
paying before the war.

《字林西报》

1939年8月19日

租户拒绝
支付租金

同山路居民
以半租居住
长达七个月

利用公共租界和法租界对房东的普遍反感情绪，上海地产有限公司在同山路的物业租户——这些租户一直居住在几排小住房和商铺中，并按半价支付租金——对公司要求全额租金的请求提出异议，并拒绝支付任何租金。因此，公司切断了所有房屋的供水。

在1937年8月13日上海战事爆发前，同山路物业的小住房和商铺月租金报价为18美元和19美元。当战事爆发后该地区发生疏散时，公司决定，如果租户希望搬回该地区，则将住房和商铺的租金均提高到每月23美元。

1938年2月，这种回流开始，约20%的住房被搬回旧居的租户占据，他们在那里免费居住。当时房屋没有供水，因此公司允许租户免费居住。随着越来越多的人入住该街区，公司于1937年11月决定向租户收取新定租金的一半，并每天分三次向租户供水。

租户的要求

此举是应租户的要求进行的，他们以前是从日本海军陆战队兵营外的消防栓取水。公司规定，如果通水，租户必须支付新租金的一半，即每月11.50美元。当时公司认为收取全额租金是不合理的，因为弄堂和小巷没有照明。

然而，上个月，公司能够24小时自由供水，开启了弄堂和小巷的灯光，并为该物业配备了一名俄罗斯看守。随后，公司向所有租户发出通告，称由于情况已基本恢复正常，且公司无限制地供水，要求租户支付全额租金，即其住房或商铺每月23美元。

租户立即将此举解读为要求在他们已支付的租金基础上增加100%，并拒绝接受公司的要求。然而实际上，这仅仅是在他们已支付的半价基础上增加50%，从而使租金达到100%，即每月23美元。即使这个数字，也仅代表比战前支付的租金增加了25%。

Higher in Settlement
To rent the same house in the
International Settlement, an official
of the company revealed to the

Considering this fact, the increase in
rent asked by the company for their

exorbitant. The tenants remain stead-
fast in their determination not to
pay, however, and have paid no heed
whatsoever to rent collectors who
have paid visits to the premises in
order to collect the rent.
These tenants are all Chinese and
cannot be sued in the First Special
District Court as they are beyond
the jurisdiction of that Court when
they are living in occupied territory.
Certainly, they will not come into
the Settlement to stand trial for
failing to pay their rent. This, in
turn, brings up the question of who
really is responsible for the interests
of third party property holders on
the other side of the Creek if they
are beyond the jurisdiction of the
Settlement authorities. For instance,
an eviction order issued by the First
Special District Court would have no
value whatsoever in the occupied
territory and could not be carried
out.
pages.zh:
租界内租金更高

该公司一名官员向《字林西报》透露，若要在公共租界租赁同样的房屋，每月需花费约60或65美元。鉴于这一事实，该公司对其位于同山路（Tongshan Road）的房产所要求的租金涨幅并不算过高。然而，租户们坚决拒绝支付，对于前来收租的收租人完全不予理睬。

这些租户均为华人，由于他们居住在沦陷区，超出了第一特区地方法院的管辖范围，因此无法在该法院被起诉。当然，他们也不会进入租界出庭受审以应对欠租指控。这进而引出了一个问题：如果苏河彼岸的第三方产权人的利益超出了租界当局的管辖范围，那么究竟谁应该对这些利益负责？例如，由第一特区地方法院签发的驱逐令在沦陷区将毫无效力，且无法执行。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS
Aug 19 1938

The Rent Racket:
Where the Trouble Started

To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS"
SIR,—I read CONTRIBUTOR'S original article and also his apologia in yesterday's paper.
As he is willing to attack anonymously people who write under their own name, he cannot complain if he himself attacked.
The original article led off by assuming that the present increase in rent and the rent racket in general are due to the depreciated dollar. This is, of course, not the trouble, or at any rate, the whole trouble. The rent racket started when Shanghai became crowded with refugees but has been intensified by the drop in the value of the dollar.
Judging from the Latin tags used by your CONTRIBUTOR, there is no doubt that he is aware of the maxim falsum in uno, falsum in omni and if, therefore, the foundation of his argument is unsound, the whole of his deductions are rotten. Rotten is perhaps the right word to use as the view of your contributor reeks strongly of vested interest. Perhaps an even better simile would be that someone is trying to make hay while the sun shines.
One point that I have not seen brought out in your columns but was mentioned by my old friend Mrs. Jones at a tea party yesterday, was that though the S.M.C. can do nothing to restrict rents, yet the S.M.C. is content to grant a 25 per cent. increase to "B" and "L" classes while allowing "B" and "L" class employees to be subject to rental increases of 70 to 80 per cent. or more.

MRS. JONES' FRIEND.
Shanghai, Aug. 18.

2374
《字林西报》
1938年8月19日

租金勒索：
麻烦始于何处

致《字林西报》编辑先生：

先生，我读了“投稿人”在原报上发表的文章以及他在昨日报纸上的辩解。既然他愿意匿名攻击那些署真名写作的人，那么当他本人受到攻击时，也就无权抱怨了。

那篇原创文章开篇便假设目前的租金上涨及普遍的租金勒索现象是由于美元贬值所致。这当然不是问题的根源，或者至少不是全部根源。租金勒索始于上海挤满难民之时，而美元价值的下跌则加剧了这一现象。

从贵报“投稿人”使用的拉丁语引文来看，毫无疑问他知晓“一处虚假，处处虚假”（falsum in uno, falsum in omni）这一格言，因此，如果他论证的基础不牢固，那么他的所有推论都是站不住脚的。用“站不住脚”这个词或许很恰当，因为贵报投稿人的观点散发着强烈的既得利益气息。也许更贴切的比喻是，有人正试图趁热打铁（make hay while the sun shines）。

我在贵报专栏中未见到提及，但我的老朋友琼斯夫人（Mrs. Jones）在昨日的茶会上提到的一点是：虽然工部局（S.M.C.）对限制租金无能为力，但工部局却满足于给予“B”类和“L”类职员25%的加薪，同时却任由“B”类和“L”类职员的租金上涨70%至80%甚至更多。

琼斯夫人的朋友
上海，8月18日

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.

AUG 19

Rent Nearly Doubled

To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS"
SIR,—With reference to the much
excited correspondence in your
esteemed daily about the rent rack-
teering in Shanghai, I cannot re-
main silent without giving a due
praise to some landlords, who regard-
less of the great temptation to
follow their unscrupulous colleagues
in raising rentals limitlessly, are
content with a very reasonable in-
crease of rentals. For instance, the
rentals of some of my acquaintances
have been increased by 12 to 20
per cent. only, since 1937.
Unfortunately I cannot boast of
having connection with that kind of
landlords. I am having an apart-
ment in one of the largest and
richest French Companies in town.
My rent has been increased by 95
per cent since the commencement
of the hostilities, and as I under-
stand, the rent will be still further
increased with the approach of cold
weather.
Of course the price of coal is very
high nowadays, but our Company
economizes on fuel by supplying us
with lukewarm water instead of hot,
and even such we get during a
limited period of time only. Last
winter, our central heating was
working in the same manner.
As I have learned, the salaries of
employees of this company had up
to now been raised by 15 to 20 per
cent. only.
To finish with this question, I
must mention that it is nearly three
years since my apartment was re-
painted and necessary repairs made
and it is now in a deplorable condi-
tion.
In view of the above facts an
enormously high increase of my
rental is hardly justified
X.
Shanghai, Aug.

《字林西报》

8月19日

租金几乎翻倍

致《字林西报》编辑先生：

先生，关于贵报上就上海租金勒索问题展开的热烈通信，我不能保持沉默，必须对一些房东给予应有的赞扬。尽管面临着追随那些无良同行无限提高租金的巨大诱惑，这些房东仍满足于非常合理的租金涨幅。例如，自1937年以来，我的一些熟人的租金仅上涨了12%至20%。

不幸的是，我无法夸口与这类房东有交集。我住在市内最大、最富有的法国公司之一拥有的公寓里。自战事开始以来，我的租金上涨了95%，而且据我了解，随着天气转冷，租金还将进一步上涨。

当然，如今煤价非常高，但我们公司通过供应温水而非热水来节省燃料，而且即便这样，我们也只能在有限的时间内获得。去年冬天，我们的中央供暖系统也是以同样的方式运行的。

据我了解，该公司员工的薪水迄今为止仅上涨了15%至20%。

最后，我必须提到，我的公寓已有近三年未重新粉刷和进行必要的维修，目前状况堪忧。

鉴于上述事实，我的租金大幅上涨是难以 justified（正当化/合理）的。

X
上海，8月

CHINA PRESS

AUG 24 1939

S. M. C. Will
Not Sponsor
Rental Board

Council Favors Scheme
But Refers B.R.A.
To Chamber

Although taking an open stand
in favor of the appointment of a
rental adjustment committee for
the arbitration of disputed rental
cases, the Shanghai Municipal
Council yesterday rejected the idea
of sponsoring such an organization.
The rejection was confirmed in a
circular notice issued to the press
last night. It stated:

"The British Residents' Associa-
tion of China has suggested to the
Council the formation of a rental
adjustment committee to which
disputed cases might be referred
for arbitration, each side having
previously agreed to abide by the
findings of the committee."

"Favorably Disposed"

"It was suggested that the
Municipal Council should sponsor
such a scheme. Both the French
authorities and the Shanghai Muni-
cipal Council are favorably dis-
posed towards the scheme, but it
is felt that the actual formation of
the committee and the drawing up
of its terms of reference should
be referred to a body such as the
General Chamber of Commerce.
"The General Chamber of Com-
merce, therefore, has been asked
whether it would undertake the
operation of this project."

It was pointed out yesterday
that while the Council is not dis-
posed to sponsor the board of-
ficially, it definitely favors the idea
of such a board being formed.

Idea Not New

The General Chamber of Com-
merce, it is understood, has taken
the matter under advisement and
is expected to take some sort of
definite action within a few days.
The idea of establishing an
arbitration committee to handle
dispute rent cases between land-
lord and tenant is not exactly new,
it has been under consideration by
the British Residents's Association
for some time and its establish-
ment also is known to be one of
the aims of the recently formed
Shanghai Tenants' Association.

（批：Til Oct 8）

《大美晚报》

1939年8月24日

工部局不会
发起成立
租金委员会

工部局赞成该方案
但将此事转交总商会

尽管上海公共租界工部局公开表态支持任命一个租金调整委员会来仲裁有争议的租金案件，但工部局昨日拒绝了发起成立此类组织的想法。昨晚发给新闻界的一份通告证实了这一拒绝。通告称：

“在华英人协会（British Residents' Association of China）向工部局建议成立一个租金调整委员会，有争议的案件可提交该委员会进行仲裁，前提是双方事先同意遵守委员会的裁决。”

“持赞成态度”

“有人建议工部局应发起此类方案。法国当局和上海公共租界工部局均对该方案持赞成态度，但认为委员会的实际组建及其职权范围的起草应移交给诸如总商会之类的机构。因此，已询问总商会是否愿意承担该项目的运作工作。”

昨日有人指出，虽然工部局不愿正式发起成立该委员会，但它确实支持成立此类委员会的想法。

此想法并非新近提出

据悉，总商会已将此事纳入审议，预计将在几天内采取某种明确的行动。建立一个仲裁委员会来处理房东与租户之间租金纠纷的想法并非全新，在华英人协会已考虑此事一段时间，且已知成立此类委员会也是最近成立的上海租户协会的目标之一。

（批注：截至10月8日）

pages.en:
CHINA DAILY NEWS,
The Rent Racket:
Currency and Landlords
AUG 2 + 1939
24050

To the Editor of the
North-China Daily News

SIR, Disregarding R. DE LA M.'s
absurd, sneering and wholly
unjustified remarks in regard to the
various correspondents, including the
writer, whose letters on behalf of
the tenant's case appeared in your
paper, as not deserving serious atten-
tion, I would like to say a few words
on the subject of the currency
situation in Shanghai as affecting the
public in general and landlords in
particular.

Thus, the depreciation is a source
of misery all round is admitted by
everybody, but if there will be any
to benefit by it it will be the land-
lords mostly. It is a well-known fact
that the majority of properties in this
city were bought with borrowed
money; the Chinese and American
Courts having been particularly
lenient in cases of foreclosure, and
should R. DE LA M.'s prediction come
true there may be a time when land-
lords will be able to repay the loans
they received in worthless bits of
paper, retaining for themselves the
full possession of the lands and
buildings they acquired with some-
body else's good money. They will
thus be in possession of solid values
no matter what happens to the dollar,
while those who have loaned them
the money will lose everything. Since
R. DE LA M. is so deeply concerned
over the landlords' "daily bread,"
perhaps he will also find a few tears
to shed over the fate of their would-
be victims.

There are also millions upon
millions invested in debentures bear-
ing a fixed rate of dividend and
repayable in local currency. Such
investors have no choice but to watch
their hard-earned savings, perhaps
savings of a lifetime, dwindle away
and with them most of their dreams
of vacations, retirements, etc. These
people have not been speculating.
Why should R. DE LA M. waste all his
sympathy on landlords when so much
of it is needed in other directions?
Indeed, one could go on naming
dozens of deserving causes, and for
the life of me I cannot see why the
public should spread itself out in
order to facilitate the ever-rising
demands for higher rents.

As I pointed out in my previous
letter, landlords now enjoy an income
of 30 to 50 per cent. higher than in
the pre-hostilities days, and I am
inclined to think that certain types
of landlords receive much more. A
French land company, for instance,
raised the rents to their foreign
tenants by 90 per cent., and is still
demanding higher rents. Does R. DE
LA M. believe that such ruthless
extortion should go on unopposed?

To be sure, there are a few who
enjoy the benefit of income from
foreign currencies. Though I am
not one of them I wish them all the
luck in the world. It is their "dog's
day," as the landlords had theirs, and
there is no more reason that they
should share their bit of good luck
with their landlords than for the
latter to give up a part of their solid
investment in property in favour of
those who have invested their money
in debentures which bear now but a
fraction of their original value. The
great bulk of tenants, however,
consists of tradespeople, clerks, pro-
fessional men, workmen, etc. who
derive their income in local currency
and who for the most part find it
difficult to meet the high cost of
living as it is. They give to the
landlord his full share, and more.

A few more words, to answer a
question put by R. DE LA M.—any law
which protects both sides is a good
law. The Chinese Courts have shown
leniency to the tenant, but were it
not for the same law many owners
of property would have been today
paupers.

VOICE OF SHANGHAI.
Shanghai, August 22.

《大美日报》，
租金勒索：
货币与房东
1939年8月2+日
24050

致《字林西报》编辑先生

先生，我不理会 R. DE LA M. 针对包括笔者在内的各位通讯员发表的荒谬、嘲讽且毫无根据的言论，他认为我们代表租户一方刊登在贵报上的信件不值得认真对待。在此，我想就上海的货币形势及其对公众特别是房东的影响说几句。

诚然，大家都承认货币贬值是各方痛苦的根源，但如果有人能从中受益，那主要是房东。众所周知，本市大部分房产是用借来的钱购买的；中美两国法院在没收抵押品案件中一直特别宽大。如果 R. DE LA M. 的预测成真，可能会有那么一天，房东能够用毫无价值的纸币偿还他们获得的贷款，同时将他们用他人的硬通货购得的土地和建筑物完全据为己有。这样，无论美元发生什么变化，他们都拥有实物资产，而借钱给他们的人则将失去一切。既然 R. DE LA M. 如此关心房东的“糊口之资”，也许他也能挤出几滴眼泪，为那些潜在的受害者的命运哀叹一番。

此外，还有数以百万计的资金投资于固定股息率并以本地货币偿还的债券。这些投资者别无选择，只能眼睁睁看着他们辛苦积攒的储蓄——也许是一生的积蓄——逐渐缩水，随之破灭的还有他们度假、退休等大部分梦想。这些人并没有从事投机活动。既然其他地方如此需要同情心，R. DE LA M. 为何要将所有的同情心浪费在房东身上呢？的确，人们可以列举出数十个值得同情的理由，但我实在看不出公众为何要四处奔波，以助长不断高涨的加租要求。

正如我在上一封信中指出的那样，房东现在的收入比战前高出30%至50%，而且我认为某些类型的房东收入增加得更多。例如，一家法国地产公司将外籍租户的租金提高了90%，并且仍在要求更高的租金。R. DE LA M. 是否认为这种无情的勒索应当不受反对地继续下去？

当然，也有少数人享有外币收入的好处。虽然我不是其中一员，但我祝愿他们好运连连。这是他们的“得意之时”（dog's day），正如房东曾有过他们的得意之时一样。他们没有理由与房东分享这点好运，正如房东没有理由放弃部分坚实的房产投资，去 favor（优待）那些投资于债券的人——这些债券现在的价值仅为原始价值的一小部分。然而，绝大多数租户由商人、职员、专业人士、工人等组成，他们的收入来源是本地货币，而且大多数人发现即使维持现状也难以应付高昂的生活成本。他们已经向房东支付了全额甚至更多的份额。

再补充几句，以回答 R. DE LA M. 提出的一个问题——任何保护双方的法律都是好法律。中国法院对租户表现出宽容，但若不是因为有同样的法律，许多房产所有者今天可能已成为赤贫者。

上海之声
上海，8月22日

pages.en:
Le Journal de Shanghai. August 20, 1939

THE RENT CRISIS IN SHANGHAI.

(Editorial)

Shanghai to-day is passing through a rent crisis; this usually accompanies a social or economic breakdown.
The known apparent causes of the crisis are: over-population of the two Foreign Settlements. The International Settlement has now a population of about 2,000,000, this being an increase of 900,000, while the population of the French Concession has risen by 480,000 to 1,200,000. On the other hand, there has been very little building. Naturally, this had the tendency of sending rentals soaring by virtue of the law of supply and demand.. To this tendency must be added another factor: the continual drop in the value of the Chinese dollar.
From the viewpoint of the landlords, the problem at first sight seems simple enough: one has only to adjust the rent according to the exchange.
In the eyes of the tenants, the solution is equally simple: the commonest is one demanding legislation prohibiting the raising of rent.
Need one to recall that in all social and economic problems whose causes are multiple and complicated, all radical solutions which are considered as the most simple only make matters worse. This remark is applicable to the rent problem in Shanghai. The solutions put forward are impracticable and impossible; some are actually disastrous
The majority of the residents of Shanghai earn their living in Chinese dollars but their earnings have not kept pace with the changes in the value of the dollar. The disproportion between the drop in the dollar and increases in salary has been enormous. This disproportion would mean in the case of a family of modest income an adjustment of the rent at pre-war rate and this would absorb all the earnings of the family. This is by no means an exceptional case nor is this a case of theory only.
Take, for instance, a family in which the husband is earning $150 a month; he is now earning $225. The wife's salary of $125 has been increased to $187.50. Their total earnings are $412.50. They pay $100 for an apartment of two rooms, bath and kitchen at the time when the Chinese dollar was 9.50 francs or $15 to a pound sterling. This rent is reasonable.
To-day the pound sterling is quoted at $60. If a readjustment is made in the rent of this family on the basis of the pound sterling, the family will have to pay a rent of $400. This case well illustrates the almost insurmountable difficulties facing a solution of this rent problem in Shanghai.
On the other hand, the tenants are suggesting the adoption of the universal panacea: the passing of legislation prohibiting the raising of rentals. But this also is impracticable. The rent from property constitutes one of the most important sources of income in a city like Shanghai. The prohibition of the raising of rentals would, in the case of Shanghai, mean a reduction of income by 75%.
pages.zh:
《上海日报》。1939年8月20日

上海的房租危机。

（社论）

上海目前正经历一场房租危机；这种危机通常伴随着社会或经济的崩溃。
已知的明显危机原因是：两个外国租界人口过剩。公共租界目前人口约为2,000,000人，增加了900,000人，而法租界的人口则增加了480,000人，达到1,200,000人。另一方面，建筑施工却寥寥无几。自然，根据供求规律，这导致了租金飙升的倾向。除了这一倾向外，还必须加上另一个因素：中国货币价值的持续下跌。
从房东的角度来看，这个问题乍一看似乎很简单：只需根据汇率调整租金即可。
在房客眼中，解决办法同样简单：最常见的要求是通过立法禁止提高租金。
是否有必要提醒人们，在所有原因多重且复杂的社会和经济问题中，那些被视为最简单的激进解决方案只会使事情变得更糟？这一评论适用于上海的房租问题。提出的解决方案既不切实际也不可能；有些甚至实际上是灾难性的。
上海大多数居民以中国货币赚取生计，但他们的收入并未跟上币值变化的步伐。货币贬值与薪资增长之间的不成比例是巨大的。这种不成比例意味着，对于一个收入微薄的家庭来说，如果按战前比率调整租金，将耗尽该家庭的所有收入。这绝非特例，也不仅仅是理论上的情况。
例如，有一个家庭，丈夫每月收入150元；他现在收入225元。妻子的薪水从125元增加到187.50元。他们的总收入为412.50元。在中国货币价值为9.50法郎或15元兑1英镑时，他们支付100元租用一套两室、带浴室和厨房的公寓。这个租金是合理的。
今天，英镑报价为60元。如果根据英镑对该家庭的租金进行重新调整，该家庭将不得不支付400元的租金。这个案例很好地说明了在上海解决这一房租问题所面临的几乎不可逾越的困难。
另一方面，房客们建议采用通用的万灵药：通过立法禁止提高租金。但这也是不切实际的。房产租金构成了像上海这样的城市最重要的收入来源之一。禁止提高租金在上海意味着收入减少75%。

pages.en:
-2-

This will have far-reaching repercussions on
the economic life of the city: there will be restrictions
on the purchasing of goods and of articles of luxury, the
building and repairing of houses will cease---, in short,
a general business depression. Labourers, clerks and other
class of workers will be discharged and this will result
in many tenants not being in a position to pay their rents.
Social and economic troubles will then follow.
It should be noted that this is not all theory
for this is exactly what has happened in France.
Progressive taxation of rent , not the mere
prohibition of rent increase, has been in force in France
since 1919. Nobody can deny that it has been one of the
aggravating causes of the many crises that have troubled
France. Meanwhile, the legislator, who is all-powerful
in France, has always sought to mitigate the rigours of
the taxation by means of compensations to landlords.
Nevertheless, in the matter of legislation prohibiting the
raising of rent, one should consider whether it is likely to
be passed and what the consequences of such legislation
would be, for it touches the question of the civil rights
of the inhabitants.
On the question of civil rights, all residents
in the French Concession are amenable to their respective
national laws, that is to say, the Chinese will be amenable
to the Chinese Civil Code, the British to British law and
so on for the nationals of thirteen Treaty Powers.
For a tax to be imposed on a Chinese or British or any
other foreign landlord and for their respective Courts to
enforce the tax on their nationals, it will be necessary
to secure the consent of these Powers to an amendment to
their laws. Much difficulty will be experienced in
securing the consent of these legislative bodies to such
an amendment of their laws.
Furthermore, if property in the French
Concession is to be taxed in this way, it is not to be
supposed that property in the International Settlement
will remain untouched. That would be a case of glaring
inequality of treatment. It will be necessary therefore
to secure the consent of the Shanghai Municipal Council.
We believe we are right in saying that an
attempt was made in this direction at the beginning of the
Sino-Japanese hostilities with a view to finding a solution
to the rent question by a building commission.
Instead of blaming our authorities who are not
responsible for the crisis from which we are suffering,
we should trust them not to take any path that is full of
precipices.

X. L.

-2-

这将对城市的经济生活产生深远的影响：商品和奢侈品的购买将受到限制，房屋的建造和修缮将停止——简而言之，将出现全面的商业萧条。劳工、职员和其他阶层的工人将被解雇，这将导致许多房客无力支付租金。随后将出现社会和经济动荡。
应当指出，这并非纯粹的理论，因为这正是法国发生的情况。
自1919年以来，法国一直实行租金累进税，而不仅仅是禁止提高租金。无人能否认，这是困扰法国的众多危机的加剧原因之一。与此同时，在法国拥有至高权力的立法者一直试图通过对房东进行补偿来减轻税收的严苛性。
尽管如此，在关于禁止提高租金的立法问题上，人们应考虑其通过的可能性以及此类立法的后果，因为它触及居民的公民权利问题。
关于公民权利问题，法租界的所有居民均受其各自国家法律的管辖，也就是说，中国人受中国民法管辖，英国人受英国法律管辖，其他十三个条约国的国民亦同理。
若要对中国人、英国人或任何其他外国房东征税，并由其各自的法院对其国民执行该税收，就必须获得这些强国对其法律修正案的同意。要获得这些立法机构对此类法律修正案的同意，将面临诸多困难。
此外，如果法租界的房产要以这种方式征税，那么就不能假设公共租界的房产会不受影响。那将是明显的待遇不平等。因此，必须获得上海工部局的同意。
我们认为可以这样说，在中日敌对行动开始时，曾尝试朝这个方向努力，试图通过一个建筑委员会来寻找解决房租问题的方案。
我们不应指责那些对我们所遭受的危机不负责任的当局，而应信任他们不会采取任何充满险阻的道路。

X. L.

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY.

' 8 1930

Japanese Press
Club Annoyed

Protest On 50 Percent
Increase Made
To Landlord

The Shanghai Japanese
Press Club, which has its
headquarters in the Pearce
Apartments in Hongkew,
Thursday afternoon filed a
protest with Mr. A. W.
Buck, manager of the Shang-
hai Land Investment Co. Ltd.,
against a 50 per cent increase
in rent.
The protest stated that the
club would not pay 'the rent
until the company had come
to an understanding. Other
tenants of the apartment building
had joined them in fighting the
rent increase, the protest said.
This action of the company, the
protest declared, would lead to a
wholesale rise of rents in Hong-
kew and thus work a serious
hardship on Japanese residents.

Other Protests
The Japanese Press Club is by
no means alone in protesting
against a Hongkew rent hike, as
there have been protests galore
south of the creek by tenants in
recent weeks, with the result that
in some cases landlords have
agreed to conferences with them.
One of the most popular forms
of rent-increasing by landlords
has been to charge whole or part
rentals in sterling or gold dollars,
which has brought complaints
from Chungking.

Japanese Example
North of the Soochow Creek
landlords have found it necessary
to increase rentals, by varying
amounts.
An example of rent raising can
be seen in the action of the new
Japanese management of the
Broadway Mansions in increasing
all rentals by 30 percent for one
month, after which all rentals
were to be paid in Hongkew
money at 6 d. to the "dollar."

（批：FILE）
（批：Cig 1/8）

《上海晚邮报及信使报》。

' 8 1930

日本记者俱乐部感到恼火

就向房东提出50%的
增幅提出抗议

上海日本记者俱乐部总部设在虹口皮尔斯公寓（Pearce Apartments），周四下午向上海地产有限公司经理A. W. Buck先生提交了一份抗议书，反对租金上涨50%。
抗议书称，在公司达成共识之前，俱乐部将不支付租金。抗议书称，该公寓楼的其他租户也加入了他们对抗租金上涨的行列。抗议书宣称，公司的这一行动将导致虹口地区租金全面上涨，从而给日本居民带来严重的困难。

其他抗议
日本记者俱乐部绝非唯一抗议虹口租金上涨的团体，最近几周，苏州河以南的租户提出了大量抗议，结果在一些情况下，房东同意与他们进行会谈。
房东增加租金最流行的形式之一是收取全部或部分英镑或金圆券租金，这引起了重庆方面的抱怨。

日本人的例子
在苏州河以北，房东发现有必要不同程度地提高租金。
百老汇大厦的新任日本管理层将所有租金提高30%为期一个月，之后所有租金将以每“元”6便士的汇率用虹口货币支付，这就是一个涨租的例子。

（批注：归档）

NEWSMEN LEAD RENT
INCREASE PROTEST

Object To Basing Of Part

Value Of Dollar

Japanese newspapermen to-day
were in the van of an anti-landlord
campaign in Hongkew, as they
sought to organize the tenants of
the Pearce Apartments, situated
at the corner of Boone and Chapoo
Roads, in a protest against a re-
cent rise in rents.
According to the "Tairiku
Shimpo," the Shanghai Land Invest-
ment Company, owners of the
building, on August 1 notified their
tenants that beginning this month,
one-fourth of the rental would be
collected at the pre-devaluation
rate of dollar exchange when the
Chinese yuan was pegged at 1

This would bring an actual in-
crease of from $160 to $240 for a
typical apartment, the paper said.
This is a 50 per cent. raise.
The Shanghai Japanese Journ-
alists Association with club rooms
in the Pearce Apartments on

urging them to join a movement
of protest, the newspaper declared.
The "higher-rent parade" was
launched by the Broadway Man-
sions, now owned by the Shanghai
Heng Chang Company, a Sino-
Japanese firm, last month, when
tenants were notified of a 35 per
cent. raise on their rents beginning
on August 1 while beginning Sep-
tember 1 rents would be quoted in
Hua Hsing yuan pegged at 6d.

新闻界人士领导抗议
租金上涨

反对部分租金按
美元旧值计算

日本新闻工作者今天走在虹口反房东运动的前列，他们试图组织位于博恩路（Boone Road）和乍浦路（Chapoo Road）拐角处的皮尔斯公寓的租户，抗议最近的租金上涨。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,

AUG 1 1 1939..

A Letter Praised
To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS"
SIR,—Through the medium of your paper I wish to congratulate H. S. WAVELL most heartily for the very best letter yet published in connection with the rent racket.
The loyalty of the S.V.C. and Police Specials to the interests of this city is the most amazing feature of Shanghai's present-day abnormality. A common question among Shanghailanders now is why the S.V.C. and Police Specials should voluntarily serve and risk their lives in maintaining peace and order in this city when the wealthy and influential section of Shanghai's population are doing their best to foster struggle, disorder and enmity among the poorer classes.
The S.M.C. has assumed the role of a blind and deaf invalid; therefore one should not be surprised if one day we witness a kind of indignation gesture on the part of "small fry" of this city by resignation "en bloc" from their voluntarily assumed duties.
I understand H. S. WAVELL's letter is a warning to the S.M.C., and before it is too late it is strongly suggested that the S.M.C. issue another "Emergency Proclamation" to curb the voracious appetite of racketeering landlords and profiteering à la mode.
OLD TIMER.
Shanghai, Aug. 10.

（批：11/8）

1939年8月11日..

一封受到赞扬的信
致《字林西报》编辑
先生，——谨借贵报媒介，衷心祝贺H. S. WAVELL发表了迄今为止关于房租勒索问题的最佳信件。
上海义勇队（S.V.C.）和警察特别队员对本市利益的忠诚，是上海当前异常状况中最令人惊讶的特征。上海外籍居民现在的一个普遍问题是，当上海富有和有影响力的阶层极力在较贫穷阶层中助长斗争、混乱和敌意时，上海义勇队和警察特别队员为何要自愿服务并冒着生命危险来维持本市的和平与秩序。
工部局扮演了一个又盲又聋的病人的角色；因此，如果我们有一天目睹本市“小人物”通过集体辞去自愿承担的职责来表达愤怒，也不必感到惊讶。
我理解H. S. WAVELL的信件是对工部局的警告，强烈建议在为时已晚之前，工部局发布另一项“紧急公告”，以遏制敲诈勒索的房东和时髦的投机商人的贪婪胃口。
老住户。
上海，8月10日。

PROSPECTUS.
OF THE
INTERNATIONAL TENANTS ASSOCIATION IN HONGKEW.

1. The above named association was founded in the beginning of
September 1939 under Japanese laws, which are now valid in
the areas occupied by the Japanese troops, and is controlled
by the competent authorities.

2. Every house, store, apartment and room tenant in Hongkew
shall become a member of the association, which will be advised
and protected by Japanese lawyers.

3. The organization will regulate the whole real estate and
housing market in Hongkew:-
a) by fighting the real estate-house-room rent profiteering,
i.e. putting an end to key money, and by abolishing the
request of landowners to pay the lease in foreign currency.
b) by solving disputes through a proposed court of arbitration.
c) by setting up compulsory rules for hygienic and sanitary
installations in the existing houses, and premises to be
erected in the future. The amount of such installations,
apart from the minimum necessities will depend upon the
amount of the lease.
d) by giving members of the association expert advise in all
renting and buying affairs, particularly the signing of
contracts.
e) by building up-to-date communal dwellings on the instalment
system.
f) by protecting the safety and financial interest of the
members and their families, by establishing a Sickness,
Theft, Burglary, Accident, Life and Fire Insurance to
which members would subscribe at a reasonable rate.

4. Every House, Store, Apartment and Room tenant who wants to
join this association must pay an initial amount of Yen 1.-
and will receive a membership card.
pages.zh:
章程
虹口国际租户协会

1. 上述协会于1939年9月初根据日本法律成立，该法律目前在日军占领区有效，并由主管当局监管。

2. 虹口的所有房屋、商店、公寓及房间租户均应成为协会会员，协会将由日本律师提供咨询和保护。

3. 本组织将规范虹口整个房地产和住房市场：-
a) 通过打击房地产、房屋及房间租金暴利，即杜绝顶费（key money），并废除业主要求以外币支付租金的规定。
b) 通过拟议的仲裁法庭解决纠纷。
c) 为现有房屋及未来将建场所的卫生和卫生设施制定强制性规则。除最低必需品外，此类设施的规模将取决于租金数额。
d) 在租赁和买卖事务中，特别是在签订合同时，为协会会员提供专家建议。
e) 以分期付款制度建造现代化的公共住宅。
f) 通过建立疾病、盗窃、入室盗窃、意外、人寿和火灾保险，并以合理费率供会员投保，从而保护会员及其家属的安全和经济利益。

PROSPEKT
der
INTERNATIONALEN MIETER VEREINIGUNG in HONGKEW.

1. Die obengenannte Vereinigung wurde Anfang September 1939 unter Japanischen Gesetzen gerguendet, welche jetzt in von japanischen Truppen besetzten Gebieten gueltig sind, und wird von den zustaendigen Behoerden kontrolliert.
2. Jeder Haus, Laden, Apartment und Zimmer Mieter in Hongkew soll Mitglied der Vereinigung werden, welche von japanischen Advokaten beraten und beschuetzt wird.
3. Die Organization bezweckt die Regelung des gesamten Grundstuecks-und Wohnungs-marktes in Hongkew:
(a) durch Bekaempfung des Grundstuecks-Haus-und Mietzinswuchers, durch Beseitigung des Schluesselgeldes und durch Ausschluss von Forderungen des Mietzinses in auslaendischer Waehrung,
(b) durch Klaerung entstandener Streitfragen mittels eines im einzelnen noch festzulegenden Schiedsgerichtes,
(c) durch Aufstellung allgemeinverbindlicher Richtlinien fuer hygienische und sanitaere Einrichtung in den bestehenden, resp. zu erbauenden Haeusern. Richtungebend wird hierbei, abgesehen von unbedingten Minimalforderungen, die Hoehe des Mietzinses sein.
(d) durch fachgemaesse juristische Beratung der Mitglieder bei allen Kauf-Pacht und Mietsangelegenheiten, insbesondere beim Abschluss von Vertraegen. Grundlage ist bei letzterem der im Besatzungsgebiet geltende Einheitsmiets-vertrag.
(e) durch den Bau von modernen Ein-resp. Mehrfamilienhaeusern auf dem Wege der Amortisierung.
(f) durch persoenliche, resp. materielle Sicherung des Mitgliedes resp. seiner Familie in Form eines Beitritts zu einer Krankenkasse ferner Diebstahl und Einbruch resp. Unfall, Sterbe-und Feuerversicherung zu besonders guenstigen Bedingungen.
4. Jeder Haus, Laden, Apartment und Zimmer-Mieter, welcher in diese Vereinigung eintreten will, muss als Eintrittsgeld Yen 1.00 zahlen und bekommt eine Mitgliedskarte.
5. Jedes Mitglied muss der Vereinigung am Ersten jedes Monats im voraus sein Mitglieds-gebuehr wie folgt zahlen:

章程
虹口国际租户协会

1. 上述协会于1939年9月初根据日本法律成立，该法律目前在日军占领区有效，并由主管当局监管。
2. 虹口的所有房屋、商店、公寓及房间租户均应成为协会会员，协会将由日本律师提供咨询和保护。
3. 本组织旨在规范虹口整个房地产和住房市场：
(a) 通过打击房地产、房屋及租金高利贷，消除顶费，并排除以外币支付租金的要求，
(b) 通过尚待详细确定的仲裁法庭澄清产生的争议问题，
(c) 为现有及待建房屋的卫生和卫生设施制定具有普遍约束力的指导方针。在此方面，除绝对最低要求外，租金数额将作为指导依据。
(d) 在所有购买、租赁和出租事务中，特别是在签订合同时，为会员提供专业的法律咨询。后者的基础是占领区适用的统一租赁合同。
(e) 通过摊销方式建造现代化的单户或多户住宅。
(f) 通过加入医疗保险，以及盗窃、入室盗窃、意外、死亡和火灾保险，以特别优惠的条件保障会员或其家庭的人身或物质安全。
4. 任何希望加入本协会的房屋、商店、公寓及房间租户必须支付入场费日元1.00，并获得会员卡。
5. 每位会员必须在每月第一天向协会预付其会员费，如下所示：

PROSPECTUS
OF THE
INTERNATIONAL TENANTS ASSOCIATION IN HONGKEW

1. The above named association was founded in the beginning of
September 1938 under Japanese laws, which are now valid in
the areas occupied by the Japanese troops, and is controlled
by the competent authorities.

2. Every house, store, apartment and room tenant in Hongkew
shall become a member of this association, which will be advised
and protected by Japanese lawyers.

3. The organization will regulate the whole real estate and
housing market in Hongkew:-
a) by fighting the real estate-house-room rent profiteering,
i.e. putting an end to key money, and by abolishing the
request of landowners to pay the lease in foreign currency.
b) by solving disputes through a proposed court of arbitration.
c).by setting up compulsory rules for hygienic and sanitary
installations in the existing houses, and premises to be
erected in the future. The amount of such installations,
apart from the minimum necessities will depend upon the
amount of the lease.
d).by giving members of the association expert advise in all
renting and buying affairs, particularly the signing of
contracts.
e).by building up-to-date communal dwellings on the instalment
system.
f).by protecting the safety and financial interest of the
members and their families, by establishing a Sickness,
Theft, Burglary, Accident, Life and Fire Insurance to
which members would subscribe at a reasonable rate.

4. Every House, Store, Apartment and Room tenant who wants to
join this association must pay an initial amount of Yen 1.-
and will receive a membership card.

Date March 13, 19 40.

Subject .... Karukes, Soviet citizen.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by ....

Enquiries show that L.M. Karukes, age about 42,
Soviet citizen of Jewish origin, arrived in Shanghai some
time during 1935 from Harbin where he is reported to have
been employed with the Economic Bureau of the Chinese
Eastern Railway and also to have been working as a cor-
respondent to certain Soviet newspapers.

In Shanghai he was employed with the Soviet news-
paper "New World" ( later renamed "China Daily Herald" )
until 14-10-37 when the newspaper went out of existence.
Although there is no direct evidence to this effect, he
is believed to have been connected with the "Rotary Press"
140 Canton Road, since the end of 1937, when this enter-
prise was established by a group of Soviet citizens, in-
cluding several former employees of the "China Daily He-
rald".

He is also reported to be a partner in the "Fleet's
Book Store", 798 Avenue Joffre, where Mrs. N. Karukes nee
Miroshnikoff, his wife, is employed.

The Karukes couple and Mrs. E.P. Miroshnikoff, mother
of Mrs. Karukes, are reported to be active members of the
Soviet citizens club, 805 Avenue Foch. In 1939 when a plan
of opening a school for Soviet citizen's children was dis-
cussed, Mrs Miroshnikoff was mentioned as a candidate for
the post of Headmistress of the proposed school.

Karukes is reported to have a good working know-
ledge of the Chinese language.

Enquiries from Russian and Chinese sources have
so far failed to trace any connection between Karukes

调查显示，L.M. 卡鲁克斯（Karukes），约42岁，犹太裔苏联公民，于1935年某时从哈尔滨抵达上海，据称他曾在中东铁路局经济局任职，并曾为某些苏联报纸担任记者。

在上海，他受雇于苏联报纸《新世界》（后更名为《中国每日先驱报》），直至1937年10月14日该报停刊。虽然没有直接证据证明这一点，但据信自1937年底该企业由一群苏联公民（包括几名前《中国每日先驱报》员工）成立以来，他便与广东路140号的“罗塔里印刷厂”（Rotary Press）有关联。

另据报道，他是霞飞路798号“弗利特书店”（Fleet's Book Store）的合伙人，其妻N. 卡鲁克斯夫人（婚前姓米罗什尼科夫 Miroshnikoff）在该店工作。

据报道，卡鲁克斯夫妇及卡鲁克斯夫人的母亲E.P. 米罗什尼科夫（Miroshnikoff）女士是福煦路805号苏联公民俱乐部的活跃成员。1939年，在讨论为苏联公民子女开办学校的计划时，米罗什尼科夫女士被提名为拟议学校校长的候选人。

据报道，卡鲁克斯具备良好的中文工作能力。
